{{Top}}
{{Quote|Dad, what's kriffing?"<br />"Nothing—a bad word. Your mother won't be happy I said it in front of you.|Ben Skywalker and his father|<ref name="The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>}}
This is a list of '''phrases, interjections, slang, insults, and expletives''' used in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
{{CompactTOC}}
==0&ndash;9==
*'''#Chicken Alarm''': A hazard assessment used by [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] Teams that followed the sequence 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13. An assessment of 13 was a [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] sighting, 8 was a fleet arriving in a system, 5 was a solitary [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], 3 was a ground army, 2 was a small fleet, 1 was any other sizable operation.<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>
*'''#G's''': Number of hostile aliens (7G's, 8G's).<ref name="GG9" />
*'''100 percent''': A slang term for "perfect" used by [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]]<ref name="TCD">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref><ref name="Galaxy at War">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
*'''10 percent''': A slang term used by ARC troopers<ref name="TCD" /><ref name="Galaxy at War" /> and clone troopers,<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> meaning "terrible"<ref name="TCD" /><ref name="Galaxy at War" /> or referring to a worst-case scenario.<ref name="TCD" />
*'''23er''': Alliance Intelligence slang for an agent who made twenty field assignments and retired. Considered any competent agent in SpecOps.<ref name="GG9" /><ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />
*'''3-9 line''': [[Starfighter/Legends|Fighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] slang for a line going across a fighter's wings, based on an imaginary clock, in which 12 is straight ahead and 6 is behind. The goal is to keep any enemy fighter in front of the 3-9 line.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

==A==
*'''ABH''': [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|SpecOps]] slang for average Bounty Hunter, though could also mean an above-average [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Acceptable losses''': [[Deal-slang]] for what a [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] would consider the least acceptable way to do business; their bottom line.<ref name="Gambler's Life">{{Journal|4|It's a Gambler's Life}}</ref>
*'''Achieve zero visibility''': Deal-slang for to duck or hide out.<ref name="Gambler's Life" />
*'''ACM''': [[Starfighter/Legends|Fighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] slang for aerial combat maneuvering, aka dogfighting.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
*'''Acquisition run''': SpecOps slang for a combat operation that presents opportunities for a large-scale theft.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''[[Aiwha/Legends|Aiwha]]-bait''': Used by ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to refer to [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]].<ref name="RC:TZ">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world idiom "shark bait."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/shark+bait|text=shark bait|quote=1. ''slang'' A person swimming or surfing alone in the ocean.
|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20241209011304}}</ref>
*'''Alert all commands''': An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] order.<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>
*'''All the [[Caranak/Legends|caranaks]] in a row''': Phrase meaning "all present and accounted for".<ref name="Allies" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "get/have your ducks in a row."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/get-have-your-ducks-in-a-row|text=get/have your ducks in a row|quote=to be well prepared or well organized for something that is going to happen|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230608135929}}</ref>
*'''Almosters''': [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] slang for residents of [[Lanthrym]].<ref name="Planets Three">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]''</ref>
*'''Alphabet soup''': Military slang for acronyms.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
*'''Anchorite''': Someone who lives in seclusion.<ref name="Overlords">{{TCW|Overlords}}</ref> Real-world noun.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/anchorite|text=anchorite|quote=a person who lives in seclusion usually for religious reasons|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20230308223216}}</ref>
*'''[[Diathim/Legends|Angel]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]]''': Used by [[Clive Flax]] to address [[Astri Oddo]].<ref name="Master of Deception">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception]]''</ref>
*'''Another kettle of [[Giju/Legends|Giju]]''': A completely different example; another case.<ref name="OF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> Similar to the real-world phrase "be another kettle of fish."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/be-another-a-different-kettle-of-fish|text=be another/a different kettle of fish|quote=to be completely different from something or someone else that has been talked about|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625195925}}</ref>
*'''AO''': Military slang for area of operations. Also, an omnipresent term for the place where a mission takes place.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
*'''Ape''': Light insult used by an [[Unidentified stormtrooper (Apocalypse Endor)|Unidentified]] stormtrooper [[Platoon leader/Legends|Platoon Leader]].<ref name="AE">{{Tales|14|Apocalypse Endor}}</ref>
*'''Aruetii''': [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]] for foreigner, outsider, and at worst, traitor.<ref name="SWRC">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref>
*'''As slippery as a greased [[Dug/Legends|Dug]]''': Untrustworthy.<ref name="OF" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "as slippery as an eel."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/(as)+slippery+as+an+eel|text=(as) slippery as an eel|quote=Devious, scheming, and untrustworthy—and difficult or impossible to apprehend or pin down.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20220812215336}}</ref>
*'''As smooth as the surface of a [[Neutron star/Legends|neutron star]]''': Very smooth.<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> Similar to the real-world idiom "as smooth as a baby's bottom."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/as-smooth-as-silk-a-baby-s-bottom|text=as smooth as silk/a baby's bottom|quote=extremely smooth|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20241209010412}}</ref>
*'''[[Astral]]''': Adjective used to convey approval, similar to "awesome."<ref name="Star by Star">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>
*'''As stubborn as a [[Ronto/Legends|ronto]] in [[Reproduction/Legends|rut]]''': Very stubborn.<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world idiom "as stubborn as a mule."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/%28as%29%20stubborn%20as%20a%20mule|text=(as) stubborn as a mule|quote=extremely stubborn|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20241209010021}}</ref>
*'''Aurora borealis skyfire''': A phrase used around [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]] to describe something with vivid, shimmering [[Color/Legends|colors]].<ref name="OF" />
*'''Aw, nuts''': Expression of dismay.<ref name="LSSM">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref> "Nuts" is a real-world exclamation.
*'''AWOL''': Military slang for absent without leave; the same as desertion in some militaries.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
*'''Azkanc''': [[Sullustese/Legends|Sullustan]] pejorative term for a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>
*'''Azzameen Sneak''': A phrase coined by [[MK-09/Legends|MK-09]] to describe the attempted, yet ineffective, covert tactics of members of the [[Azzameen family]], most notably [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]].<ref name="XWAPrima">[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

==B==
*'''Baay Shfat''': An obscenity of unknown origin about [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].<ref name="SWRC" />
*'''Babe''': Slang term for an attractive young woman; used by [[Oked/Legends|Oked]] about [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]],<ref name="Bounty">{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}}</ref> and [[Cade Skywalker]] to address [[Darth Maladi]].<ref name="Legacy 15">[[Legacy (2006) 15|''Legacy'' (2006) 15]]</ref> Real-world slang.
*'''Baby''': An affectionate way of addressing someone, especially a lover;<ref name="Hunt for Ziro" /> also used by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to address his [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]''.<ref name="ANH" /> Real-world noun.
*'''Back-blade''': To betray.<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world verb "backstab."
*'''Back Door''': [[Gallisport]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] slang. An easy entrance or exit, usually created by the gang when it was needed.<ref name="SG">{{Journal|6|Swoop Gangs}}</ref>
*'''Backrocket''': Adjective, usually a derogatory modifier, used figuratively to mean backwards, quaint, or inferior.<ref name="DS" /><ref name="Cuss">{{Blog|abelgpena|5|A Mouth Like An Intergalactic Princess: Cussing In A Galaxy Far, Far Away}}</ref>
*'''Bad batch''': A group of failed [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="Clone Cadets">{{TCW|Clone Cadets}}</ref>
*'''Bad-batcher''': A defective clone trooper.<ref name="Clone Cadets" />
*'''Bad idea''': [[Deal-slang]] for a risky deal with little to no profit potential.<ref name="Gambler's Life" />
*'''Bad karma''': During [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], this was Imperial trooper slang for a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
*'''Bag of [[Bantha dung/Legends|bantha droppings]]''': A worthless person.<ref name="Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world idiom "pile of shit."<ref name="Pile of shit">{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/pile+of+shit|text=pile of shit|quote=1. ''vulgar slang'' A lot of malicious or ignorant lies.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20250710225907}}</ref>
*'''Bag of [[Hair/Legends|fur]]''': Used by [[Warto]] to refer to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].<ref name="SW8">[[Star Wars (1977) 8|''Star Wars'' (1977) 8]]</ref>
*'''[[Bantha/Legends|Bantha]]''': An insult, e.g. "you brainless, [[Louse/Legends|lice]]-ridden bantha."<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> Also a derogatory [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Hovertank/Legends|tank]] crew term for an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]].<ref name="RB">{{Journal|9|Repulsortank Battlefield}}</ref>
*'''Bantha [[Brain/Legends|brain]]''' or '''bantha-brain''': A stupid person.<ref name="Firefight">''[[Rebel Force: Firefight]]''</ref><ref name="Goatgrass" /> Similar to the real-world insult "birdbrain."<ref name="Birdbrain">{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/birdbrain|text=birdbrain|quote=a stupid person|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230627220250}}</ref>
*'''Bantha-breath''': An insult.<ref name="JQTDG">''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]''</ref>
*'''[[Bantha dung/Legends|Bantha droppings]]''': Nonsense; e.g. "spare us the bantha droppings"<ref name="Rogue Squadron 10">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 10|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 10]]</ref> or "your story's so much bantha droppings."<ref name="Legacy 41">[[Legacy (2006) 41|''Legacy'' (2006) 41]]</ref> Similar to the real-world noun "bullshit."
*'''[[Bantha dung/Legends|Bantha dung]]''': A swear word.<ref name="Play It Again">{{StoryCite|story=Play It Again, Figrin D'an: The Tale of Muftak and Kabe|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> Could also refer to something very unlikeable.<ref name="TEoD" /> The former is similar to the real-world swear word "shit," while the latter is similar to the vulgar noun "bullshit."
*'''[[Bantha fodder/Legends|Bantha fodder]]''': Slang term for a person deemed to have no value beyond something for a bantha to feed on;<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> worthless or waste, e.g., "You won't be worth bantha fodder."<ref name="Galaxy Guide 7">''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''</ref> Also used as a synonym for nonsense, e.g. "That's the biggest through of bantha fodder I've ever heard anyone spit up in my life,"<ref name="Conquest" /> and deal-slang for when a promised deal did not come through.<ref name="Gambler's Life" /> The use of the word is similar to the real-world vulgar noun "shit," while "bantha fodder" as a synonym for nonsense is also similar to the real-world noun "bullshit."
*'''Bantha herder''': An insult.<ref name="JO" />
*'''Bantha in the room''': A difficult issue that no one wants to discuss,<ref name="Omen" /> resembling the real-world phrase "elephant in the room."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/elephant-in-the-room|text=elephant in the room|quote=If you say there is an elephant in the room, you mean that there is an obvious problem or difficult situation that people do not want to talk about.|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230327125012}}</ref>
*'''Bantha Rider''': Derogatory [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Hovertank/Legends|tank]] crew term for an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] crew.<ref name="RB" />
*'''Bantha spew''': See '''bantha fodder'''.<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world noun "bullshit."
*'''[[Barve/Legends|Barve]]''': A slang term, loosely equivalent to pig.<ref name="BLT:TJP">''[[A Barve Like That: The Tale of Boba Fett]] - [[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]''</ref>
*'''Barvy''': Crazy.<ref name="Abyss" />
*'''Bastard''': An insult used by [[Isplourrdacartha Estillo]] against the alleged murderer of her family.<ref name="Rogue13">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 13|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 13]]</ref> Real-world noun.
*'''Bastasi''': An [[Ansionian]] expletive, used to indicate an individual's loss of patience or extreme exasperation.<ref name="TAS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>
*'''Battery''': SpecOps term for a lot of Imperials huddled together, enough to even make a SpecOps agent nervous.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Battlecan''': Canny and/or aggressive military veterans.<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref>
*'''BBH''': Boring Bounty Hunter. SpecOps term for common target practice bounty hunters.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Bear''': SpecOps term for a [[Balinaka]].<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Been had''': A phrase used by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] meaning "been fooled" or "been tricked."<ref name="SW11">[[Star Wars (1977) 11|''Star Wars'' (1977) 11]]</ref> "Be had" is a real-world phrase.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/be-had|text=be had|quote=to be tricked and given less than you agreed or paid for|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230702140128}}</ref>
*'''Be trapped between the [[Black Hole of Nakat/Legends|Black Hole of Nakat]] and the [[Magataran Maelstrom/Legends|Magataran Maelstrom]]''': To be in a situation where you have to choose between two equally unpleasant courses of action.<ref name="Shadow Hunter">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref> Variant: '''caught between a black hole and a maelstrom'''.<ref>[[Republic 61|''Republic'' 61]]</ref> Similar to the real-world phrase "to be caught between a rock and a hard place."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/to-be-caught-between-a-rock-and-a-hard-place|text=to be caught between a rock and a hard place|quote=If you are caught between a rock and a hard place, you are in a difficult situation where you have to choose between two equally unpleasant courses of action.|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archiveurl=https://archive.is/MrL14}}</ref>
*'''Be with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]''': To [[Death/Legends|die]].<ref name="Legacy 15" />
*'''BH''': Bounty hunter.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Big Boys''': Heavy armored transports such as the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] or the [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
*'''Big finish''': Deal-slang for an unexpected violent or dramatic ending to a deal.<ref name="Gambler's Life" />
*'''Big Green Fish''': An expletive used by [[Yarbolk Yemm]].<ref name="POT">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>
*'''Big L''': Slang term for the lightspeed barrier.<ref name="SWGMSR">''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Screen, Revised]]''</ref><ref name="SWRPG2">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref><ref name="HSSE">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>
*'''Big Push''': To terminate someone.<ref name="LCMS">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>
*'''Bilateral business''': Deal-slang for conducting multiple deals.<ref name="Gambler's Life" />
*'''Binary''': Used in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] as a criticism to denote extreme stubbornness, or inability to compromise on an issue: "You can be ''so'' binary at times."<ref name="Galaxy Guide 7" />
*'''[[Bird/Legends|Bird]]''': Military slang term for [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" /> Also a word used by [[Lumiya|Shira Brie]] about [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|Imperial TIE fighters]].<ref name="SW 60">[[Star Wars (1977) 60|''Star Wars'' (1977) 60]]</ref>
*'''Birdwatcher''': SpecOps term for [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] agent.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Bishwag''': An untrustworthy being. [[Merglyn]] complained that "If you weren't so cheap, [[Havor]], you wouldn't have bought a faulty [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] from that bishwag, [[Watto/Legends|Watto]]".<ref name="Star Wars 1998 32">[[Star Wars (1998) 32|''Star Wars'' (1998) 32]]</ref>
*'''Bitch''': An offensive term for a woman.<ref name="Into the Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref> Real-world noun.
*'''Bit-pusher''': A clerk or other occupation involving a lot of [[Flimsiplast/Legends|paperwork]].<ref name="VOTF" /> Similar to the real-world noun "pencil pusher."
*'''Bitten off more than we can chew''': Slang term for "taken on a larger problem than we can handle."<ref name="SW8" /> "Bite off more than you can chew" is a real-world idiom.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/bite-off-more-than-can-chew|text=bite off more than you can chew|quote=to try to do something that is too difficult for you|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20220926223830}}</ref>
*'''Bizit''': A pejorative once used by [[Niles Ferrier]].<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>
*'''[[Color/Legends|Black]]''': SpecOps term for any large denomination, at least 1,000 credits, that is probably "blackmarked," or traceable.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''[[Black box]]''': Deal-slang for a deal for technology of a military nature.<ref name="Gambler's Life" />
*'''Blackheads''': [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] slang for [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]], named after their black caps.<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''[[Black hole/Legends|Black hole]]''': Deal-slang for a deal that has gone so bad that the consequences seem to have no end.<ref name="Gambler's Life" />
*'''Black [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]]''': A disreputable family member.<ref name="E-3PO">{{DB|droid|e3po|E-3PO}}</ref> Similar to the real-world noun phrase "black sheep."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/black-sheep|text=black sheep|quote=a person who has done something bad that brings embarrassment or shame to his or her family|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20220916085612}}</ref>
*'''Blackboots''': A nickname for the soldiers of the Galactic Alliance Guard, perhaps particularly the ground troops of the corps.<ref name="Inferno">''[[Legacy of the Force: Inferno]]''</ref>
*'''Blasted''': Intensifier used to express anger or annoyance.<ref name="Sandstorm">{{Tales|15|Sandstorm (comic story)}}</ref> Real-world adjective.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/blasted|text=blasted|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230103173226}}</ref>
*'''Blaster-brained''': Dim-witted.<ref name="Uprising">''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world insult "birdbrain."<ref name="Birdbrain" />
*'''Blaster Bolts!''': An interjection, most notably used by [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]].<ref name="YJK:HotF">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Heirs of the Force]]''</ref><ref name="JJK:VF">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: Vader's Fortress]]''</ref>
*'''Blaster fodder''': A term used for troopers who were sent on impossible missions, likely ending in their [[Death/Legends|deaths]].<ref name="MBS">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world noun "cannon fodder."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/cannon-fodder|text=cannon fodder|quote=If you describe soldiers as cannon fodder, you mean that they are not considered important by their officers and are sent into war without their leaders worrying if they die.|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20220104203758}}</ref>
*'''Blaster-happy''': Ready to react violently, esp. by shooting, on the slightest provocation.<ref name="Six Against the Galaxy">[[Star Wars (1977) 2|''Star Wars'' (1977) 2]]</ref> Similar to the real-world adjective "trigger-happy."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/trigger-happy|text=trigger-happy|quote=Someone who is trigger-happy often uses his or her gun, shooting with very little reason|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230322192941}}</ref>
*'''Blaster-slinger''': An expert with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="MJH">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref>
*'''Blast it!''': An interjection.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Old-fashioned, real-world exclamation.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/blast|text=blast|quote='''''exclamation''''' • old-fashioned informal (…) (also '''blast it''') an expression of anger|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20250720235851}}</ref>
*'''Blast off''': Used to tell someone to go away.<ref name="SW8" /> Similar to the rude real-world phrase "piss off."
*'''Bless my circuits!''' Used by a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to express surprise.<ref name="AOTC" /> Similar to the real-world old-fashioned idiom "bless my soul!"<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/bless-my-soul|text=bless my soul!|quote='''''idiom''''' old-fashioned (also '''bless me!'''); (also '''well I'm blessed!''') an expression of surprise|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20241208072024}}</ref>
*'''Bless my [[Star/Legends|stars]]''': Exclamation of shock.<ref name="Knight Errant Escape 2">[[Knight Errant: Escape 2|''Knight Errant: Escape'' 2]]</ref> Real-world exclamation.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/bless+my+stars|text=bless my stars|quote=An exclamation of surprise.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20250705200630}}</ref>
*'''Blind jump''': [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] slang for setting up a new intelligence network on a new planet.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>
*'''Blinker''': [[Gallisport]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] slang. A [[Spice/Legends|spice]] addict. So-called because of involuntary eye-blinking.<ref name="SG" />
*'''Blinking''': An expletive.<ref name="TFP">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''</ref> Phonetically similar to the real-world "fricking."<ref name="Fricking" />
*'''[[Bloah]]''': A swear word.<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref> Could also be used as part of a longer interjection, e.g. "'''what the bloah''' is that?"<ref name="The Joiner King" />
*'''Bloated One''': Mos Eisley slang referring either to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] specifically, or in a disparaging manner to any [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 7" />
*'''[[Blope]]-head''': An insult.<ref name="JQTDG" />
*'''[[Bludfly]]''': An insult.<ref name="Lando's Commandos">{{Tales|5|Lando's Commandos: On Eagles' Wings}}</ref>
*'''[[Blue milk/Legends|Blue milk]] run''': An ordinary and uneventful mission.<ref name="JO">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref> A pun on the real-world noun "milk run."<ref name="Milk run">{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/milk-run|text=milk run|quote=UK '''a trip that you make often''' US '''a journey by plane or train that stops in many places'''|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625195015}}</ref>
*'''[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba]]-ize''': Deal-slang for doing something stupid that would ruin a deal, like falling into the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Sarlacc pit]].<ref name="Gambler's Life" />
*'''[[B'omarr Order|Bomarr]] cast-off''': Insult referring to an individual rejected by the Bomarr religious sect, or an outcast.<ref name="Cuss" /><ref name="KOTOR" />
*'''Bombad''': Superlative, used mainly by Gungans.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>
*'''Bone''': Pilot slang for a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]].<ref name="IJ">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>
*'''Bongo''': Slang term for a hit man.<ref name="SW7">[[Star Wars (1977) 7|''Star Wars'' (1977) 7]]</ref> Not to be confused with the [[Bongo|Gungan vehicle]].<ref name="TPM" />
*'''Boost-Bot''': [[Gallisport]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] slang. A [[Droid/Legends|droid]] created to help the gangs steal [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] and spare parts.<ref name="SG" />
*'''Borg''': Slang term for [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]].<ref name="SW7" />
*'''Borg-licker''': An insult used by individuals who were prejudiced against cyborgs to refer to individuals who did not share their prejudice.<ref name="SW7" />
*'''Boring''': A SpecOps term in reference to a mission. Either considered extremely dangerous or no threat at all, or both at the same time. Only truly understood by SpecOps agents.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Borked''': An adaptable expletive; see '''farkled'''.<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> Similar to the real-world vulgar adjective "f*cked."
*'''Boys in Black''': Slang term for the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]].<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref>
*'''Boys-in-black''': Deal-slang for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] customs officers.<ref name="Gambler's Life" />
*'''[[Boys in Blue]]''': Slang term for [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] and [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]].<ref name="RC:TZ" /><ref name="SenateGuardencyc">{{SWE|groups|senateguard|Senate Guard}}</ref> See also: '''Cop''' and '''seccer'''.
*'''Boys-in-brown''': Deal-slang for [[Security Police/Legends|Espo]] troops.<ref name="Gambler's Life" />
*'''Boys in White''': Slang term for [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="GG9" /><ref name="SWGMSR" /><ref name="SWRPG2" /><ref name="SW4">[[Star Wars (1977) 4|''Star Wars'' (1977) 4]]</ref>
*'''Boys-in-white''': Deal-slang for [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="Gambler's Life" />
*'''Brainbolted''': Derogatory modifier suggesting robotic or unthinking behavior.<ref name="Inferno" />
*'''Brainless''': Stupid.<ref name="TPM" /> Real-world adjective.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/brainless|text=brainless|quote=stupid|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20220503213643}}</ref>
*'''Braintick''': An insult,<ref name="Tempest" /> referring to an arachnid that attached itself to a host's brain.<ref name="Cuss" />
*'''Brass Mine''': SpecOps term for a Special Operative.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Brat''': A child who behaves badly.<ref name="Rebel Dream">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref> Real-world noun.
*'''[[Braze]]''': Air pollution; short for "brown haze."<ref name="ZHR">''[[Zorba the Hutt's Revenge]]''</ref>
*'''Bright''': Slang term commonly used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]]/[[New Republic/Legends|Republic]] pilots, in reference to the [[TIE/Advanced starfighter]].<ref name="XRS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>
*'''Brine breath''': Insult used by [[Nym]] about [[Sol Sixxa]].<ref name="S:C2">[[Starfighter: Crossbones 2|''Starfighter: Crossbones'' 2]]</ref>
*'''Brix''': An expletive, as in "What the brix are you doing here?"<ref name="OF" />
*'''Broggle''': An act that denotes surprise, as in "I'll be broggled!"<ref name="OF" /><ref name="Cuss" />
*'''BTAD''': Deal-slang for boring typical average deal.<ref name="Gambler's Life" />
*'''Bubble [[Brain/Legends|brain]]''': Insult used by [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] toward [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref> Similar to the real-world insult "birdbrain."<ref name="Birdbrain" />
*'''Bucket''': Clone trooper helmet. Similar to the [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]] term ''buy'ce''.<ref name="RC:TZ" />
*'''[[Buckethead/Legends|Buckethead]]''': A rebel term for an [[TIE pilot|Imperial pilot]] or [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]];<ref name="FC">''[[Star Wars: Force Commander]]''</ref> Also a derogatory term for [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]],<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref> and most likely also other soldiers wearing [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]].<ref name="Cuss" />
*'''Bombad''': A superlative used by [[Gungan]]s.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>
*'''Bucket of bantha spit''': Worth very little; e.g. "You could buy his loyalty with a bucket of bantha spit."<ref name="Rogue Squadron 29">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 29|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 29]]</ref> Similar to the real-world idiom "don't amount to a bucket of spit."<ref name="Spit bucket">{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/don%27t+amount+to+a+bucket+of+spit|text=don't amount to a bucket of spit |quote=Something is utterly worthless.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230624162659}}</ref>
*'''Bucket of bolts''': A term for a [[Droid/Legends|droid]], used by [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]].<ref name="SWRC" /> It has also been used to refer to a starship.<ref name="ESB" /> Real-world idiom for a run-down piece of machinery, such as a car.<ref name="Bucket of bolts">{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/bucket+of+bolts|text=bucket of bolts|quote=a machine, such as a car or a motorcycle, that is old, run-down, or worn-out. |work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20240317192747}}</ref>
*'''Bucket of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] drool''': Nonsense.<ref name="Rogue Squadron 22" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "don't amount to a bucket of spit."<ref name="Spit bucket" />
*'''Bug''': [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]].<ref name="SWBF2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref><ref name="Legacy of Terror">{{TCW|Legacy of Terror}}</ref>
*'''BUG''': Big Ugly Guy. SpecOps term for any hostile alien.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Bugger''': Derogatory word for a Geonosian,<ref name="Weapons Factory">{{TCW|Weapons Factory}}</ref> and possibly other [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Cuss" />
*'''Bug-face''': A derogatory word for a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
*'''Bughugger''': Derogatory word for a [[Joiner]].<ref name="The Joiner King" />
*'''Buggie''': A [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]].<ref name="SW7" /><ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>
*'''Bug-lover''': An insult<ref name="Battle for Endor">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref> aimed at [[Youngling/Legends|children]].<ref name="Cuss" />
*'''Bugslut''': An insult.<ref name="Tempest" />
*'''Bumblefluff''': Exclamation meaning "nonsense."<ref name="LSSM" />
*'''Burnin{{'}}''': An expletive.<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref>
*'''Burn sky until we see lines''': Fly until you get into hyperspace.<ref name="KOTOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>
*'''Burn your skyarches''': To make something impossible to return to an earlier state.<ref name="Specter of the Past" /> Equivalent to the real-world phrase "burn [your] bridges."
*'''Burning skies!''': Exclamation, possibly unique to [[Froz]] or [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="AAC">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>
*'''Burning space''': Term for flying through space using [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight engines]] at extremely fast speeds.<ref name="Specter of the Past" /> Equivalent to the real-world term, "burning rubber", when referring to cars.
*'''Burnout''': Spacer slang referring the loss of power in a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] power plants.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
*'''Bursting''': SpecOps term that referred to either throwing a live grenade or [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] down the throat of a large opposing predator, or entering a known enemy trap and using its firepower against itself.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Businessman''': [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] slang for [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]].<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''Busy''': Alliance Intelligence slang for stormtrooper.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />
*'''Busted vacc suit''': Alliance Intelligence slang for cover blown.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />
*'''Buy the Depp''': Mos Eisley slang for dying, usually violently. Coined in reference to the [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] death of [[Prefect/Legends|Prefect]] [[Orun Depp]], likely by the [[Mos Eisley Police Authority|local police force]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 7" /><ref name="Tatooine Manhunt">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref>
*'''Buzzer''': Slang for a battle droid [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAP]], mainly used by a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]].<ref name="SWBF2" />
*'''By all of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's]] [[Ghost (folklore)/Legends|ghosts]]!''': An exclamation.<ref name="IJ" /> Similar to the real-world exclamation "by God."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/by+God|text=by God|quote=4. An exclamation of shock or surprise. ''By God, you startled me! I didn't even hear you come in.'' 5. An exclamation of satisfaction or enjoyment. ''By God, that has to be one of the tastiest burgers I've had in years!''|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230702143235}}</ref>
*'''By my [[Parent/Legends|mother's]] wattle''': Said by a [[Steggus|Targonnian]], as a way of expressing strong sincerity, i.e. "Get [[Klorr Vilia|him]] down from [[Tank/Legends|there]] at once, or by my mother's wattle I'll shoot him down!"<ref name="Droids 6">[[Droids (1995) 6|''Droids'' (1995) 6]]</ref> Similar to the real-world expression "on my life,"<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.reverso.net/english-definition/on+my+life|text=on my life|quote=1. ''(emphasis)'' used to emphasize the truth of a statement <small>UK</small> (…) 2. ''(affirmation)'' with all honesty and seriousness|work=[[Wikipedia:Reverso (language tools)|''Reverso English Dictionary'']]|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/zZZFq}}</ref> and the [[Wikipedia:British English|British English]] interjection "on my soul."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.reverso.net/english-definition/on+my+soul|text=on my soul|quote=UK (…) 1. ''(promise)'' expresses strong sincerity or a solemn promise|work=[[Wikipedia:Reverso (language tools)|''Reverso English Dictionary'']]|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/zZZFq}}</ref>
*'''[[Byss (Abyssin)/Legends|Byss']] Blind [[Eye/Legends|Eye]]!''': Non-[[canon]] exclamation,<ref name="Ghost">{{Tales|11|Ghost (comic story)}}</ref> referring to the one-eyed [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] and their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Cuss" />
*'''By the Center of Everything''': See '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="LCSTB">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]''</ref>
*'''By the Core''': See '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="The Joiner King" /><ref name="LCFO">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>
*'''By the [[Cosmic Egg]]!''': [[Nediji]] exclamation; see '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="MJH"/>
*'''By the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]!''': See '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="Dark Empire II audio">[[Dark Empire II (audio drama)|''Dark Empire II'' audio drama]]</ref>
*'''By the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Heart/Legends|heart]]!''': See '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="Side Trip 2">"[[Side Trip]]"</ref>
*'''By the Emptiness!''': See '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="LCMS" />
*'''By the Eternal!''': See '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="LCMS" /><ref name="LCFO" />
*'''By the Eternal Core!''': See '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="LCMS" />
*'''By the Force!''': See '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="TAS" /><ref name="Obsession 1">[[Obsession 1|''Obsession'' 1]]</ref><ref name="DLotSA">[[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]]</ref>
*'''By the Four [[Moon/Legends|Moons]]!''': An exclamation, possibly used only by the citizens of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]; see '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="KOTOR2" />
*'''By the [[Grand Protector]]!''': A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] exclamation; see '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="S:C2" />
*'''By the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]]!''': See '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="DLotSA" />
*'''By the Holy Stars!''': See '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="CE6">[[Crimson Empire 6|''Crimson Empire'' 6]]</ref>
*'''By the [[Immortal gods of the Sith/Legends|Immortal gods of the Sith]]''': See '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="SW6">[[Star Wars (1977) 6|''Star Wars'' (1977) 6]]</ref>
*'''By the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean's]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]]!''': A [[Mere]] exclamation; see '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="S:C2" />
*'''By the Original Light''': See '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="HSSE" />
*'''By the Great Lens''': See '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="LCSTB" />
*'''By the jewel of Haarkan''': See '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="BTS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>
*'''By the [[Star/Legends|stars]]''': See '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Weapon of the Jedi|Tython}}</ref>
*'''By the Thousand Tides''': A [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] invocation; see '''by all of Alderaan's ghosts!'''<ref name="TCD" />

==C==
*'''Can of corrosion''': An insult.<ref name="The Joiner King" /><ref name="Cuss" />
*'''Can't''': SpecOps term for a tank, by deliberately misspelling the word.<ref name="GG9" /><ref name="RB" />
*'''Captain Obvious''': A pejorative for someone who is oblivious to an obvious situation. [[Nick Rostu]] once addressed [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] as such.<ref name="SP">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>
*'''Carbon Flush''': Vulgar expression used to indicate an extremely displeasing situation.<ref name="Void I">"[[Emissary of the Void]]"</ref>
*'''Cargo hold''': [[Spacer/Legends|Spacers]]' slang for backside,<ref name="KOTOR2" /> effectively similar to the real-world rude word "ass."
*'''Case Green''': Military code meaning no resistance or all is clear.<ref name="XRS" />
*'''Case Yellow''': Military code meaning light resistance.<ref name="Rogue Squadron 22" />
*'''Cat''': SpecOps term for an [[Orryxian]].<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Catnot''': Contraction of "Categorically Not." SpecOps term for [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="GG9" />
*'''CB''': Cybernetic Bronchitis. SpecOps term for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Cee-cee''': Pronunciation of the acronym for "Command Center" (CC).<ref name="TKR">''[[The Kathol Rift]]''</ref>
*'''Ceiling''': [[Planetary shield/Legends|Planetary shield]] coverage.<ref name="RB" />
*'''Chakaar''': [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]] for "thief" or "grave robber"; used as a general term of abuse.<ref name="SWRC" />
*'''Chakta sai kae''': Old [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] toast.<ref name="VOTF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>
*'''A [[chalarax]] can't change its spots''': Proverb meaning that one cannot change the basic way one is.<ref name="Revan5">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', Chapter 5</ref> Similar to the real-world phrase "a leopard cannot change its spots."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/a-leopard-cannot-change-its-spots|text=a leopard cannot change its spots|quote=If you say that a leopard cannot change its spots, you mean that people or things are not able to change their basic characteristics, especially when you are critical of those characteristics. |work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625185656}}</ref>
*'''[[Chaos/Legends|Chaos]] take me!''': Mild expletive suggesting the subject is doing something they know is unwise.<ref name="LCMS" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "heaven help somebody."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/heaven-help-someone|text=heaven help sb|quote=You say ' Heaven help someone' when you are worried that something bad is going to happen to them, often because you disapprove of what they are doing or the way they are behaving.|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625185930}}</ref>
*'''Chaos take something''': Used to say that the speaker not care about something, e.g. "Chaos take your mission!"<ref name="ANH novel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref> Similar to the real-world idiom "to hell with someone/something."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/to-hell-with|text=to hell with someone/something|quote=used to say that you do not care about someone or something|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625165110}}</ref>
*'''Charge up her loading ramp''': Slang for sexual intercourse.<ref name="KOTOR2" />
*'''Check!''': Military phrase used by clone commando drilling sergeants for ceasing fire.<ref name="RC:TZ" />
*'''Checkout Time''': Phrase meaning time to leave.<ref name="HSSE" />
*'''Cheeka''': Woman.<ref name="Legacy glossary 3">''[[Star Wars Legends Epic Collection: Legacy Vol. 3]]'' alien language glossary</ref>
*'''Cheespa bo coopa''': Phrase translated as "better watch it."<ref name="Legacy glossary 3" />
*'''Cherfer-brained''': Dim-witted.<ref name="Specter of the Past" /> Similar to the real-world insult "birdbrain."
*'''Cherry Bombs''': [[Gallisport]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] slang for [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]].<ref name="SG" /> In real life, "cherry bomb" is an [[Wikipedia:American English|American English]] word for a form of firecracker.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/dictionary/cherry-bomb|text=cherry bomb|quote=''US'': a round firecracker that makes a loud noise when it explodes|work=''The [[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|Britannica]] Dictionary''|archivedate=20220818143241}}</ref>
*'''Chewing the luna-weed''': Phrase used to describe someone who is acting crazy.<ref name="SW10">[[Star Wars (1977) 10|''Star Wars'' (1977) 10]]</ref>
*'''Chikra''': [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] term of endearment for children.<ref name="Mara Jade 4">[[Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand 4|''Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand'' 4]]</ref>
*'''Chicken''': SpecOps term for any Imperial operation or personnel.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Chicken walker''': Rebel slang for an Imperial [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] walker.<ref name="SWBF2" />
*'''Chipbrain''': Insulting term for a droid.<ref name="TG" /> Similar to the real-world noun "birdbrain."<ref name="Birdbrain" />
*'''Chirps''': [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] slang for droids that communicated via beeps and whistles rather than [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''Chizk''': A derogatory term commonly used during the era of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref>
*'''[[Choobies/Legends|Choobies]]''': Slang term for oneself or one's rear end,<ref name="HSSE" /><ref name="GTSWU1">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> e.g. "pull our choobies out of the conflagration."<ref name="HSSE" /> Effectively similar to the real-world rude word "ass."
*'''Chorus Girl''': SpecOps term for an Imperial AT-ST walker.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Chrono's counting''': Phrase meaning that time is limited.<ref name="VOTF" /> Equivalent to the real-world phrases "clock's ticking" and "time's ticking".
*'''Chuba!''': [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] for hey; you/hey you.<ref name="GPBTG" /><ref name="Legacy glossary 3" /> Literally, another word for "[[Gorg/Legends|gorg]]."<ref name="Legacy glossary 3" />
*'''[[Chubba]]''': A swear word.<ref name="TG" />
*'''Chuff-sucking''': Derogatory modifier used by [[Jariah Syn]]<ref name="SWL3">[[Legacy (2006) 3|''Legacy'' (2006) 3]]</ref> and [[Ree-Yees/Legends|Ree-Yees]].<ref name="Goatgrass">{{StoryCite|story=Goatgrass: The Tale of Ree-Yees|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> Similar to the real-world noun "suck-egg," referring to someone who is young, stupid, or despicable.<ref name="Suck-egg">{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/suck-egg|text=suck-egg|quote=1: a young, foolish, or contemptible person|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20230621194752}}</ref>
*'''Chucked under the speeder''': A term meaning that one has openly saved him- or herself from condemnation at the expense of a comrade.<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref> similar to the real-world idiom "throw someone under the bus."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/throw-under-the-bus|text=throw someone under the bus|quote=to do something harmful to someone else in order to gain an advantage for yourself|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230308101633}}</ref>
*'''Chut chut''': Simple phrase meaning "never mind."<ref name="Legacy glossary 3" />
*'''Civvies''': Slang term for civilians, or civilian clothing.<ref name="RC:HC">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref> Real-world noun.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/civvies|text=civvies|quote=ordinary clothes that are not part of a uniform|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625191213}}</ref>
*'''Clambake''': A blaster fight.<ref name="SW7" />
*'''[[Clanker/Legends|Clanker]]''': Slang term used by clone troopers to describe [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droids]]<ref name="SWRC" /> because of the "clanking" sound they make while marching.<ref name="Ambush decoded">{{TCW|Ambush|d=y}}</ref>
*'''''Class-D''{{'}}ed''': Slang term for [[Class-D annihilation|''Class-D'' annihilation]]. Considered profanity by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]], as this form of [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptor]] technology was outlawed galaxy-wide and believed to target [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]], thereby eradicating matter from detection in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] itself&mdash;a phenomenon the Jedi viewed as the ultimate affront to life. Can be used figuratively: "I feel pretty kriffing ''Class-D''{{'}}ed."<ref name="SkyeWalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>
*'''Clear skies''': Phrase used to wish someone a good journey.<ref name="HSSE" /><ref name="SWR">[[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]]</ref><ref name="HSLL">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref>
*'''Cloak and blade''': Clandestine.<ref name="Specter of the Past" /> Similar to the real-world expression "cloak-and-dagger."
*'''Clown''': Insult.<ref name="ROTSn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> Real-world word.
*'''Clytard''': Intensifier.<ref name="VOTF" />
*'''Codger''': A whimsical term for an elderly man. Both [[Serji-X Arrogantus]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] used the term to refer to the [[Old One]].<ref name="SW9">[[Star Wars (1977) 9|''Star Wars'' (1977) 9]]</ref><ref name="SW10" /> Real-world noun.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/codger|text=codger|quote=an old man, especially one who is strange or humorous in some way|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625191326}}</ref>
*'''Comm call''': Slang meaning a conversation carried out by using an electronic communications device.<ref name="HSSE" />
*'''Commo''': Slang used for anything related to communications.<ref name="HSSE" /><ref name="HSLL" />
*'''Cold-shirt crossing''': The dangerous feat of traveling through the vacuum of space without an [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]], from one [[Life support/Legends|life-supporting]] environment to another.<ref name="Specter of the Past" />
*'''Cold-shirting it''': See '''Cold-shirt crossing'''.<ref name="Specter of the Past" />
*'''[[Conduit worm/Legends|Conduit worm]]''': Used by [[Borkus/Legends|Borkus]] to insult [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]].<ref name="CWMIA">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref>
*'''Connect-disconnect''': Slang term used to describe a one-night stand.<ref name="MBS" />
*'''Connecting the [[navpoint]]s''': Phrase meaning a comprehensive attempt at illustration or explanation of a subject.<ref name="Obsession 1" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "connect-the-dots."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/connect-the-dots|text=connect-the-dots|quote=bringing together information from different places|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625191448}}</ref>
*'''Coop''': SpecOps term for a lot of chickens (Imperials) huddled together.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Coot''': A disrespectful term for an elderly man. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] used the term to refer to [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]], and [[Jolee Bindo]] used the term to refer to himself.<ref name="KOTOR" /><ref name="SW5">[[Star Wars (1977) 5|''Star Wars'' (1977) 5]]</ref> Real-world [[Wikipedia:American English|American English]] noun.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/coot|text=coot|quote=<small>US informal</small> an old man who has an unusual or slightly crazy way of behaving |work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625191611}}</ref>
*'''[[Police officer/Legends|Cop]]:''' A slang term to describe [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] officers specifically with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]<ref name="RC:TZ" /> and the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]].<ref name="BWGITDB">{{DB|organization|bespinwingguard|Wing Guard}}</ref> Real-world slang. See also: '''Seccer'''.
*'''Corellian overdrive''': Phrase meaning doing whatever one needs to do in order to get to where one needs to get to.<ref name="RJR">[[Return of the Jedi (radio)|''Return of the Jedi'' radio drama]]</ref>
*'''CorSec''': Shorthand for [[Corellian Security Force]].<ref name="VOTF" />
*'''Cosmic deck''': A colloquial term referring to fate, comparing it to a deck of cards.<ref name="HSSE" />
*'''Country bumpkin''': A pejorative for unsophisticated country folk.<ref name="TCWNP">''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''</ref> Real-world term.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/bumpkin|text=bumpkin (also country bumpkin)|quote=a person from the countryside who is considered to be awkward and stupid|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20191006191223}}</ref>
*'''Crab-boys''': [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] slang for [[Yuuzhan Vong]]; referring to their [[Vonduun Skerr Kyrric|Vonduun crab armor]].<ref name="Practical">''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]''</ref>
*'''A [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] for your thoughts''': Phrase meaning "What's on your mind?" or "Tell me what you're thinking."<ref name="JT">''[[Jedi Trial]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world phrase "a penny for your thoughts."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/penny-for-your-thoughts|text=(a) penny for your thoughts|quote=said when you want to know what another person is thinking, usually because they have been quiet for a while|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20221210135326}}</ref>
*'''Credits talk''': Phrase meaning that [[Currency/Legends|money]] gives you power.<ref name="Falling Star">{{Tales|15|Falling Star}}</ref> Similar to the real-world idiom "money talks."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/money-talks|text=money talks|quote=said about people or organizations that are rich, and can therefore get or do what they want|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625192014}}</ref>
*'''Creespa''': Crispy; slang term for [[Death/Legends|dead]].<ref name="Legacy glossary 3" />
*'''Crink''': An expletive, used in the phrase '''"go crink yourself'''."<ref name="Allegiance">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref><ref name="Renegade">''[[Rebel Force: Renegade]]''</ref> Derogatory modifier '''crinking'''.<ref name="Allegiance" /> The latter is similar to the vulgar real-world swear word "f*cking," while the former is similar to the vulgar real-world phrase "go f*ck yourself."
*'''Crisping''': Slang term presumably relating to death by [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].<ref name="Legacy 4">[[Legacy (2006) 4|''Legacy'' (2006) 4]]</ref>
*'''Cripes''': A term that expressed disappointment, and exasperation.<ref name="SWBF2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref><ref name="Legacy of Terror" /> Real-world [[Wikipedia:British English|British English]] excamation.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/cripes|text=cripes|quote=<small>''exclamation''UK old-fashioned informal</small> an expression of surprise|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625192249}}</ref>
*'''Cross''': Slang term commonly used by [[Invids|Invid]] pilots, in reference to the [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]].<ref name="IJ" />
*'''Cuddly''': SpecOps term for Incredibly Dangerous.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Cute''': SpecOps term for Extremely Dangerous.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Cut the chatter''': Military phrase used to order all non-important messages spoken over a comms frequency to cease.<ref name="ANH" /><ref name="Specter of the Past" />
*'''Cut the [[Poodoo/Legends|poodoo]]''': Term used to ask someone to get to the point.<ref name="Bloodlines" /> Similar to the rude real-world slang term "cut the shit."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/Cut+the+shit|text=cut the shit|quote=''rude slang'' To stop fooling around. Often used as an imperative.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230203051621}}</ref>
*'''Cut the phobium''': Phrase meaning "stop lying."<ref name="DF:SFTE">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world offensive idiom "cut the crap."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/cut-the-crap|text=cut the crap!|quote=a rude way of telling someone to stop saying things that are not true or not important|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625192441}}</ref>

==D==
*'''Dag''': Expletive;<ref name="TEoD">''[[Boba Fett: Twin Engines of Destruction]]''</ref> similar to the real-world [[Wikipedia:American English|American English]] exclamation "dang."<ref name="Dang">{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/dang|text=dang|quote='''''exclamation''''' US informal '''used to express anger'''|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625174628}}</ref>
*'''Damn''': An expletive used to express anger, annoyance, disgust, etc.<ref name="ESB" /><ref name="XWA" /><ref name="Rebel Strike">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref><ref name="KOTOR2" /> Also used for emphasis, such as in "damn good."<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Real-world expletive/word.
*'''Damp down your power core''': [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] expression for "cool down."<ref name="TG" />
*'''Dampa''': Word used by [[Cade Skywalker]] meaning "planet" or "rock."<ref name="SWL7">[[Legacy (2006) 7|''Legacy'' (2006) 7]]</ref>
*'''Dang-blamed''': An expletive adjective used by [[Rawk|"Bantha" Rawk]].<ref name="SWL24">[[Legacy (2006) 24|''Legacy'' (2006) 24]]</ref> "Dang" is a real-world [[Wikipedia:American English|American English]] exclamation"<ref name="Dang" />
*'''Dark Greetings''': An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] greeting.<ref name="GODV">''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]''</ref><ref name="LCOTJ">''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]''</ref>
*'''Darkspace''': [[Yuuzhan Vong]] term for [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="TFP" /><ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>
*'''Dassadeo krova''': A [[Ysannan/Legends|Ysannan]] curse.<ref name="Empire's End 1">[[Empire's End 1|''Empire's End'' 1]]</ref>
*'''Dataworm''': Slang for a person obsessed with bookkeeping and the like.<ref name="Elusion Illusion">[[Elusion Illusion]]</ref>
*'''[[Death/Legends|Dead]] as [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]]''': Term for non-functioning.<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world expression "dead as a doornail."<ref name="Doornail">{{WebCite|url=https://grammarist.com/idiom/dead-as-a-doornail|author=Osmond, Candace|text=Dead as a Doornail – Origin & Meaning|quote=The phrase "dead as a doornail" is often used to describe something completely inactive, dead, or no longer functioning.|work=Grammarist|archivedate=20230625183948}}</ref>
*'''Dead as a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] list of friends''': (About a place) dead; quiet, with nothing interesting happening.<ref name="Scoundrels">''[[Scoundrels]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world expression "dead as a doornail."<ref name="Doornail" />
*'''Dead as a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] rivet''': Deceased.<ref name="Be Still my Heart">{{StoryCite|story=Be Still My Heart: The Bartender's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> Similar to the real-world expression "dead as a doornail."<ref name="Doornail" />
*'''[[Dead blade]]''': Term for a simple blade, no more than a sharp object such as a piece of metal, ceramic, [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]], or even [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. It was considered crude, as compared to a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] or other technology.<ref name="SP" />
*'''Deader than a [[Triton Moons|Triton Moon]]''': Phrase used to describe something dead.<ref name="ESB novel">[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]]</ref> Similar to the real-world phrase "deader than a doornail."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/dead+as+a+dodo|text=dead as a dodo|quote=
*'''dead as a dodo''' and *'''dead as a doornail'''; '''deader than a doornail''' dead; no longer in existence.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625184420}}</ref>
*'''Dead in the [[Water/Legends|water]]''': Failed and unlikely to be successful in the future.<ref name="Lando's Commandos" /> Real-world idiom.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/be-dead-in-the-water|text=be dead in the water|quote=If something is dead in the water, it has failed and it seems impossible that it will be successful in the future|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230702190127}}</ref>
*'''Dead man''': ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' slang for cloned soldiers in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="RC:HC" />
*'''Deck monkey''': Slang for someone who worked in a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]].<ref name="DS" />
*'''Dead Men''': [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] for the crews of armored vehicles.<ref name="RB" />
*'''Deece''': Slang term commonly used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in reference to [[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-series blasters]].<ref name="RC:TZ" />
*'''Defenestrate''': Slang used by [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] teams for the act of throwing a person out of a [[Window/Legends|window]].<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Delimit''': SpecOps term for a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] or other strong opponent engaging in hand-to-hand combat. Believed to be a corruption of the phrase "De-limb it."<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Detection ceiling''': Maximum vertical range at which ground-based [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] could detect and track airborne targets.<ref name="GTSWU1" />
*'''Dets''': Slang term used for detonators.<ref name="LSSM" />
*'''Devils in space''': An exclamation.<ref name="AAC" />
*'''Did [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] wear [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|black]]?''' Used to indicate that the answer to a question you have just been asked is an obvious "yes."<ref name="Rogue Squadron 22">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 22|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 22]]</ref> Similar to the real-world idiom "is the Pope a Catholic?"<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/is-the-pope-a-catholic|text=is the Pope a Catholic?|quote=used to say that the answer to a question you have just been asked is obviously 'yes'|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230704232213}}</ref>
*'''DIE-wing''': Slang term for the [[TYE-wing]] [[Ugly/Legends|Ugly]], referring to its alarmingly low combat survivability.<ref name="XKT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>
*'''Difficult''': SpecOps term for easy.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Di'kut''': A [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] expletive meaning "idiot."<ref name="RC:HC" />
*'''A [[Decicred/Legends|dime]] a dozen''': To be common and of little value. Used by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] when talking about [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 units]].<ref name="Downfall">{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid}}</ref> Real-world [[Wikipedia:American English|American English]] idiom.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/be-a-dime-a-dozen|text=be a dime a dozen|quote=''idiom'' US (UK '''be two/ten a penny''') to be common and/or of very little value|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230603193905}}</ref>
*'''Dirt''': Slang used by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] for solid ground.<ref name="DF:SFTE" />
*'''Dirt flyer''': Phrase used by [[Jagged Fel]] to describe an atmospheric pilot.<ref name="TUF" />
*'''Dirt general''': A derogatory [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] term for a non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] military officer.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith 2">[[Jedi vs. Sith 2|''Jedi vs. Sith'' 2]]</ref><ref name="Path of Destruction" />
*'''Dirtside''': A planet's surface.<ref name="LSSM" />
*'''Dobbin''': SpecOps term for an Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]].<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Doesn't''': SpecOps term for Wookiee. See also '''don't'''.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Do [[Garral/Legends|garrals]] have freckles?''': A phrase equivalent to "Does night follow day?"<ref name="Rogue Squadron 1">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 1|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 1]]</ref> Similar to the real-world humorous offensive saying "Does a bear shit in the woods?"<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/does-a-bear-do-bears-shit-in-the-woods|text=does a bear/do bears shit in the woods?|quote=<small>humorous offensive saying</small> a rude phrase used to say that the answer to a question you have just been asked is obviously "yes"|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230703065425}}</ref>
*'''Don't''': SpecOps term for several Wookiees. See also '''doesn't'''.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Drag someone's name into the [[Poodoo/Legends|poodoo]] pit''': To damage someone's reputation.<ref name="Tempest" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "drag someone's name through the mire/mud."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/drag-name-through-the-mire-mud|text=drag someone's name through the mire/mud|quote=to damage someone's reputation by saying extremely insulting things about them|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230805214920}}</ref>
*'''Drain your [[Wikipedia:Thyristor|thyristors]]''': To cause fright or shock in someone, i.e. "I've heard stories of [[Targonn/Legends|Targonn]] that would drain your thyristors…"; spoken by a [[C-3PO/Legends|droid]] to [[R2-D2/Legends|another droid]].<ref name="Droids 6" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "make one's hair curl."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/make%20one%27s%20hair%20curl|text=make one's hair curl|quote=to cause fright, shock, or surprise in someone|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20250614075547}}</ref>
*'''Drat''': Exclamation used by [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to express annoyance.<ref name="Hunt for Ziro" /> Real-world [[Wikipedia:British English|British English]] exclamation.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/drat|text=drat|quote=drat '''in British English''' (...) an exclamation of annoyance|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20210428062822}}</ref>
*'''Dreamers''': [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] slang for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''[[The Drift/Legends|The Drift]]''': Elrood sector slang for a large cloud of gas that spans much of the sector.<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''Drink vouchers''': SpecOps term for money.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Droid Poppers''': Clone slang for [[Electromagnetic pulse grenade/Legends|EMP grenades]].<ref name="Duel of the Droids">{{TCW|Duel of the Droids}}</ref>
*'''Droiding''': A phrase to describe the effects of an EMP grenade on a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando's]] helmet.<ref name="RC:HC" />
*'''Drok It''': A [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] expletive.<ref name="HSCSSB">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world vulgar expletive "f*ck it."
*'''Droyk''': A Corellian expletive.<ref name="VOTF" /> Phonetically similar to the real-world swear word "f*ck."
*'''Drunken Mynock School of Instruction''': A slang phrase for the place where one with minimal piloting skills might have bought his or her pilot's license.<ref name="LOTF:E">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref>
*'''Dubesor''': An insult on Antipose XII.<ref name="LCFO" />
*'[[List of phrases and slang/Legends|''Dupe''']]: Slang term commonly used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]]/[[New Republic/Legends|Republic]] pilots, in reference to the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]].<ref name="XRS" />
*'''[[Duck/Legends|Duck]]''': SpecOps term for an undercover Imperial operative trying not to look like an undercover Imperial operative.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Dumb orphan''': SpecOps term for an orphan with valuable information.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Durned''': A derogatory modifier.<ref name="SWR62">[[Republic 62|''Republic'' 62]]</ref> Similar to the real-world adjective "damned."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/damned|text=damned|quote=used to express anger with someone or something|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230318123832}}</ref>
*'''Dust-ball''': Used degradingly to refer to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Sandstorm" />
*'''Dustbowl''': Used degradingly to refer to Tatooine.<ref name="Sandstorm" />
*'''Dust mote''': Slang used on Tatooine for a grain of sand.<ref name="XRS" />
*'''Dwarfnut''': [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] insult meaning "fool."<ref name="GPBTG">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>
*'''Dweezer''': An insulting noun.<ref name="Kala1">[[Droids (1994) 1|''Droids'' (1994) 1]]</ref>

==E==
*'''Earworm''': Term for a nuisance or pest.<ref name="The Joiner King" />
*'''Easy''': SpecOps term for difficult.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Easy Easy''': SpecOps term for easy.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Eat [[Poodoo/Legends|poodoo]]''': Expression of contempt toward another party.<ref name="Conquest">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref> Similar to the rude real-world slang phrase "eat shit."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/eat+shit|text=eat shit|quote=''rude slang'' An interjection expressing anger or contempt.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625182746}}</ref>
*'''[[E chu ta/Legends|E chu ta]]''': Rude<ref name="ESB" /> [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] expletive. According to sound designer [[Ben Burtt]], it's not really appropriate to translate.<ref name="GPBTG" />
*'''E-D Run''': [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] slang for the [[Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route]].<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''[[Egg/Legends|Egg]] Head''': [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] nickname for [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="Mar">{{Tales|22|Marooned}}</ref>
*'''[[Ekster]]''': A Corellian term for an offworlder who immigrated to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
*'''Elup''': An [[Alwari]] command to their noble [[Suubatar]] mounts to both arise and advance.<ref name="TAS" />
*'''Emperor's Black Bones!''': An exclamation.<ref name="XBW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>
*'''Emperor's Black Heart''': A derogatory modifier, as in, "What in the Emperor's Black Heart&hellip;?"<ref name="IJ" />
*'''Emperor's Ears''': Expletive used by Imperial officers during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="FH1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref>
*'''Emwhulb''': A [[Socorran]] expletive, meant to indicate a being of low standards and no loyalty.<ref name="Black Sands">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
*'''[[Ensterite|Enster]]''': Term for a person from the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]], used by the [[Ensterite]], a [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] sect which forbade [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] with anyone from outside the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Compare '''exter'''.<ref name="MBS" />
*'''Entertainment''': SpecOps slang for combat.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Equipment''': Slang term for one's genitals.<ref name="KOTOR2" /> Real-world slang for male genitals.<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://onlineslangdictionary.com/meaning-definition-of/equipment|text=equipment|quote=male genitals.|work=The Online Slang Dictionary|archivedate=20230321111704}}</ref>
*'''Esdee Vic''': Slang term for [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
*'''[[Security Police/Legends|Espo]]''': A slang term for a [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] soldier.<ref name="HSSE" /><ref name="THSA">''[[Star Wars: The Han Solo Adventures]]''</ref>
*'''ETLA''': SpecOps slang for Extended Three-Letter Acronym; that is, a four-letter acronym. See '''TLA'''.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Eyeball''': Slang term commonly used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] and [[New Republic/Legends|Republic]] pilots, in reference to the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/In fighter]]. Often shortened to simply "[[Eye/Legends|eye]]."<ref name="XRS" /> Later used by Cade Skywalker to refer to [[Predator-class fighter|TIE predators]].<ref name="Legacy13">[[Legacy (2006) 13|''Legacy'' (2006) 13]]</ref>
*'''Exec''': Slang for [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]].<ref name="DS" />
*'''Exter''': Ensterite term for a person from outside the Corellian system. Compare '''enster'''.<ref name="MBS" />
*'''The Extreme''': Elrood sector slang for the section of the Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route that is under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="Planets Three" />

==F==
*'''Fallen into a [[Stinger (creature)/Legends|stingers']] nest''': Found oneself in a difficult situation by accident.<ref name="Black Knight">{{SWRadio|Black Knight, White Princess, and Pawns}}</ref>
*'''Falling down a hole into heaven''': Phrase used among [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]]s to refer to the pleasant experience that came with using a high quality interface link.<ref name="Tyrant" />
*'''Fanboys''': General term for [[hovercraft]] crew used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces.<ref name="RB" />
*'''Farkled''': An adaptable expletive, as in, "We've been farkled,"<ref name="Nampi">''[[Jabba the Hutt: The Hunger of Princess Nampi]]''</ref> or used to describe a bleak or disastrous situation, as in, "We're farkled."<ref name="Sand Blasted">{{Tales|4|Sand Blasted}}</ref> Similar to the real-world offensive adjective "f*cked."
*'''Fas''': A [[Yuuzhan Vong]] expletive,<ref name="Star by Star" /> also used by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to indicate an area was clear of danger.<ref name="NJOSB" />
*'''Fatigue scanning''': SpecOps slang for looking for weak spots in an organisation or system.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Father''': Alliance Intelligence slang for its own organization.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />
*'''Fear gland''': SpecOps slang for self preservation instinct, which is considered a bad quality among them.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Fedding''': An expletive used throughout the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] of the galaxy.<ref name="GNN6">{{Journal|6|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> Similar to the real-world swear word "f*cking."
*'''Fedejik''': An expletive to describe someone stupid as in "stupid ''fedejik'' of a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="HR">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>
*'''Feech''': An [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] expletive, roughly translating to "darn" or "shoot."<ref name="COC">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref>
*'''Feed like a [[Gravel-maggot|gravel maggot]]''': Disparaging term in Mos Eisley for taking advantage of others.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 7" />
*'''Feed me to the [[Fish/Legends|fishes]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]''': A statement of incredulity.<ref name="Empire 8">[[Empire 8|''Empire'' 8]]</ref> Similar to the real-world rude [[Wikipedia:British English|British English]] exclamation "bugger me."<ref name="Bugger me">{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/bugger-me|text=bugger me|quote=EXCLAMATION Some people say bugger me to emphasize that they are very surprised about something. ''[British, informal, rude, feelings]''|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20221025090257}}</ref>
*'''Feed the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]]''': [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] slang meaning to disappear, never to be seen again; to go into hiding from [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|legal authorities]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 7" />
*'''Feek!''': [[Jawaese/Legends|Jawaeese]] exclamation.<ref name="Sand Blasted" /> Similar to the real-world swear word "f*ck."
*'''Feke''': An expletive.<ref name="DS" /> Phonetically similar to the real-world swear word "f*ck."
*'''Felek''': The [[Ansionian]] word for mentally deranged or addled.<ref name="TAS" />
*'''[[Felinx/Legends|Felinx]] and [[rodus]]''': A game.<ref name="Siege">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world noun "cat and mouse," a type of behavior akin to that of a cat playing with its prey, such as toying or tormenting someone before killing them, or an intricate game involving endless pursuit, almost getting caught and narrowly escaping.<ref name="Catnap">{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/cat%20and%20mouse|text=cat and mouse|quote=behavior like that of a cat with a mouse: such as '''a :''' the act of toying with or tormenting something before destroying it '''b :''' a contrived action involving constant pursuit, near captures, and repeated escapes|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230427211855}}</ref>
*'''Fergal''': Expletive used by [[Vilmarh Grahrk]].<ref name="SW 33">[[Star Wars (1998) 33|''Star Wars'' (1998) 33]]</ref>
*'''Ferglutz''': An expletive.<ref name="R49">[[Republic 49|''Republic'' 49]]</ref><ref name="SWR61">[[Republic 61|''Republic'' 61]]</ref>
*'''Festering''': A derogatory modifier.<ref name="Planet of Twilight">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>
*'''Few [[Starship/Legends|starships]] short of a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]''': Insane.<ref name="GOF">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Fear]]''</ref>
*'''[[Fierfek/Legends|Fierfek]]''': A [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] expletive; it means "curse" or "hex," although it is often misunderstood as "poison."<ref name="TC:TJP">''[[Taster's Choice: The Tale of Jabba's Chef]] - [[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]''</ref>
*'''Field Thorns''': [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] slang for [[Mine/Legends|mines]].<ref name="RB" />
*'''Fill yer boots''': An invitation to help oneself.<ref name="RC:TZ" />
*'''Filswik''': An expletive used by Alliance pilots.<ref name="A Day in the Life">{{Tales|12|A Day in the Life}}</ref>
*'''Final Jump''': A euphemism for [[Death/Legends|death]], used by spacers.<ref name="SWGMSR" /><ref name="SWRPG2" /><ref name="HSRevenge">''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]''</ref> Usually connoted a peaceful death. Origin is from the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|jump]] to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 7" />
