*'''Finally made his/her fortune''': [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] slang meaning that the person has died. Normally used sarcastically.<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''Fire-brand''': A term used by [[Crimson Jack/Legends|Crimson Jack]] to describe [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], perhaps meaning "troublemaker" or "hothead."<ref name="SW11" />
*'''Fire Magnet''': [[Infantry/Legends|Infantry]] term for armored vehicles.<ref name="RB" />
*'''[[Fireworks/Legends|Firework]]''': SpecOps slang for anything with a large fusion reactor.<ref name="GG9" />
*''''Firm''': Short for ''affirmative.''<ref name="Star by Star" />
*'''First twilight''': The time between the first and second sunsets in Mos Eisley.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 7" />
*'''Fish''': [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|SpecOps]] term for a fish, or a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] or other aquatic species. Also refers to trouble, depending on the context.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Fishface''': Unappealing nickname given to the [[ootoolan]]s by [[Vilmarh Grahrk]], due to their fish-like appearance.<ref name="Deal with a Demom">{{Tales|3|Deal with a Demon}}</ref> 
*'''Fishhead''' or '''fish-head''': Slang for a Mon Calamari, used by Han Solo to describe Ackbar,<ref name="BTS" /> and [[Oric Harfard]] to address [[Cilghal]].<ref name="Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>
*'''Fishing''': To hopefully search for something that may or may not be there at all.<ref name="VOTF" /> Real world term.
*'''Fishman''': A derogatory term used for a Mon Calamari.<ref name="POP">[[Empire 31|''Empire'' 31]]</ref>
*'''Flack''': An expletive used by many Imperial<ref name="VOTF" /> and Republic troops.<ref name="Fatal">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref>
*'''Flag of truce''': A (sometimes metaphorical) flag which signified a meeting between enemies would occur under a temporary cease-fire. A piece of clothing such as a [[Bandana/Legends|bandana]] could be used as the flag.<ref name="SW8" /> Real-world noun phrase for a white flag.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/flag%20of%20truce|text=flag of truce|quote= a white flag carried or displayed to an enemy as an invitation to conference or parley|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20230625173644}}</ref>
*'''Flam''': A term meaning "con" or "hustle."<ref name="Ringers">{{Journal|6|Ringers (short story)}}</ref>
*'''Flaming''': A derogatory modifier.<ref name="THSA" /> Real-world slang.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/flaming|text=flaming|quote=used to add force, especially anger, to something that is said|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625173817}}</ref>
*'''Flandon's Teeth''': An exclamatory phrase.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
*'''Flarg''': An expletive.<ref name="GFTPG">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
*'''Flatch''': A Hutt slang term with the apparent meaning to ''secure, acquire, accomplish'' or ''achieve'', as in "flatch the snatch" (abduction).<ref name=":0">{{SchAdv|6}}</ref>
*'''Flat-edge sifter''': Expression used to emphasize examining in great detail.<ref name="VOTF" /> Similar to the real-world expression "fine-tooth comb."
*'''Flizzards''': A Hutt expletive, as in "just who in the flizzards are you?"<ref name=":0" />
*'''Floob''': A [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] expletive describing one who has upset the speaker.<ref name="DS" />
*'''Flott''': An alien expletive.<ref name="HS">[[Star Wars (1977) 78|''Star Wars'' (1977) 78]]</ref>
*'''Flup''': A [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] expletive.<ref name="Void IV">"[[Emissary of the Void]]"</ref> Phonetically similar to the real-world swear word "f*ck."
*'''Flutie''': Derogatory term for the [[Ssi-ruu]].<ref name="TTAB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>
*'''Flyboy''': A slang term for a starfighter pilot,<ref name="KOTOR" /> or the pilot of any small-scale starship.<ref name="ANH" />
*'''Flying rocks''': Elrood sector slang for [[Ore carrier/Legends|ore carriers]].<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''Flying triangles''': Elrood sector slang for [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]].<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''Fofo''': Double.<ref name="Legacy glossary 3" />
*'''For Edge's sake!''': An expletive.<ref name="LCMS" /> Similar to the real-world exclamation "for God's/Christ's/goodness'/heaven's/Pete's sake."<ref name="God's sake">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ldoceonline.com/dictionary/for-god-s-christ-s-goodness-heaven-s-pete-s-sake|text=for God's/Christ's/goodness'/Heaven's/Pete's sake|quote=''spoken'' '''a)''' used when you are telling someone how important it is to do something or not to do something (&hellip;) '''b)''' used to show that you are angry or annoyed|work=[[Wikipedia: Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English|''Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English'']] |archiveurl=https://archive.ph/4LjtF}}</ref>
*'''For goodness' sake''': Used to express frustration.<ref name="Bloodlines" /> Real-world exclamation.<ref name="God's sake" />
*'''For heaven's sake''': Used to emphasize a request.<ref name="Selonia">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref> Real-world exclamation.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/for%20heaven%27s%20sake|text=for heaven's sake|quote=used to make a statement or question more forceful or to express surprise, anger, etc.|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20230330105624}}</ref>
*'''For stern's sake''': An exclamation.<ref name="Rogue Squadron 3">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 3|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 3]]</ref> Similar to the real-world exclamation "for God's/Christ's/goodness'/heaven's/Pete's sake."<ref name="God's sake" />
*'''Force-forsaken''': An expression for an unideal location that [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] has apparently neglected.<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world adjective "godforsaken."<ref name=":1">{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/godforsaken|text=godforsaken|quote=A godforsaken place is not attractive and contains nothing interesting or pleasant|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625174302}}</ref>
*'''Fossil''': A rude way of referring to an elderly person.<ref name="ANH" /> Real-word, humorous noun for an old person, especially someone who refuses to embrace new ideas.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/fossil|text=fossil|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20241228151513}}</ref>
*'''Frac''': SpecOps slang for a fraction of a credit, especially non-Imperial currency.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Frac's'blacks''': SpecOps slang for lots of money in all denominations.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''[[Frak (expletive)|Frak]]''' or '''frack''': An expletive.<ref name="SOL">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref> Phonetically similar to the real-world swear word "f*ck."
*'''Frag''': An adaptable expletive.<ref name="SP" /> Derivative '''frag it'''.<ref name="The Last Jedi">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref> It could also be short for "fragmentation," as in frag grenade.<ref name="KOTOR" /> The expletive is similar to the real-world [[Wikipedia:American English|American English]] exclamation "dang."<ref name="Dang" />
*'''Fraidee-frog''': A [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] term meaning someone who is scared.<ref name="Episode I Adventures 11: Pirates from Beyond the Sea">{{EpIAdv|11}}</ref> Similar to the real-world noun "fraidy-cat."<ref name="Fraidy-cat">{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/fraidy-cat|text=fraidy-cat|quote=someone who frightens easily or is afraid of many things |work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625172359}}</ref>
*'''Frang''': An expletive.<ref name="Shadow Games">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref> Rhymes with the real-world [[Wikipedia:American English|American English]] exclamation "dang."<ref name="Dang" />
*'''Freighter bum''': An independent [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] of a roguish bent.<ref name="HSRevenge" />
*'''Freg''': An expletive.<ref name="GG11" />
*'''[[Frell (expletive)|Frell]]''', variant '''frelling''': A curse.<ref name="SWRC" /><ref name="Disapproval">{{WizardsCite|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041223|text=Disapproval|int=Disapproval}}</ref> Similar to the real-world swear word "f*ck" and its variant "f*cking."
*'''Freq''': Short for "frequency."<ref name="DL">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>
*'''Frink''': An expletive, i.e. "what the frink?"<ref name="Side Trip 4">"[[Side Trip]]"</ref> Similar to the real-world slang word "frick."<ref name="Frick">{{WebCite|url=https://greensdictofslang.com/entry/bscmcaa|text=frick|quote=a euph. for f*ck n.; also as excl.|work=Green's Dictionary of Slang|archivedate=20230625174928}}</ref>
*'''Frillin'''': An expletive that is said when surprised.<ref name="SWBF2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref><ref name="Legacy of Terror" /> Similar to the real-world word "frickin'", a version of the word "fricking."<ref name="Fricking">{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/fricking|text=fricking|quote=(also frickin, fricken) used to emphasize what is being said, or to express anger|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625174928}}</ref>
*'''Frip''': An expletive.<ref name="DS" /> Similar to the real-world slang word "frick."<ref name="Frick" />
*'''Fripping''': An expletive used as an adjective by the natives of the planet [[Indu San/Legends|Indu San]].<ref name="DS" /> Similar to the real-world word "fricking"<ref name="Fricking" /> and the rude swear word "frigging."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/frigging|text=frigging|quote=a rude word used to give more force to an expression of anger|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625181035}}</ref>
*'''[[Frizz]]''': An expletive.<ref name="DL" /> Similar to the real-world slang word "frick."<ref name="Frick" />
*'''Frizz off''': A rude way of telling someone to go away.<ref name="SkyeWalkers" /> A pun on the rude real-world slang phrase "piss off."
*'''From the bottom of my [[Fluid sac/Legends|fluid sac]]''': Phrase used by [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowicks]] to emphasize sincerity,<ref name="Hunt for Ziro">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref> similar to the real-world phrase "from the bottom of my heart."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.macmillandictionary.com/dictionary/british/from-the-bottom-of-my-heart|text=from the bottom of my heart|quote=used for emphasizing that you are very sincere about something|work=[[Wikipedia:Macmillan English Dictionary for Advanced Learners|''Macmillan Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625181337}}</ref>
*'''From the griddle to the grave''': From a bad situation to a worse one.<ref name="TCD"/> Similar to the real-word saying "out of the frying pan into the fire."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/out-of-the-frying-pan-into-the-fire|text=out of the frying pan into the fire|quote=''idiom'' <small>saying</small> said when you move from a bad or difficult situation to one that is worse|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/KdTNh}}</ref>
*'''Frotz''', variant '''frotzed''': A swear word,<ref name="Hapes 2">{{WizardsCite|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040513hapes2|text=Hapes: Ladies First Part 2}}</ref> e.g. "I really wanted to get my hands on a gun of command, and get '''the frotz''' off of this [[Hapes/Legends|planet]]."<ref name="Hapes 4">{{WizardsCite|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040527hapes4|text=Hapes: Ladies First Part 4}}</ref> Phonetically similar to the real-world swear words "f*ck" and "f*cking."
*'''FTL''': Short for "faster than light."<ref name="LSSM" />
*'''Full of [[Poodoo/Legends|poodoo]]''': Meaning that a person is lying.<ref name="Shadow Games" /> Similar to the real-world rude slang phrase "full of shit."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/full+of+shit|text=full of shit|quote=''rude slang'' Unreliable or ridiculous; saying unfounded, incorrect, or nonsensical things.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20221203092718}}</ref>
*'''Furbag''': A usually derogatory term for a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] or other fur-covered species.<ref name="SWBF2" />
*'''Furball''': A term for a fur-covered species such as a Wookiee<ref name="SW11" /> or an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]];<ref name="ROTJ" /> could be used derogatory<ref name="SW11" /> or as a term of endearment.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Real-world word for a small, furry animal, particularly one that is pleasant to hold or touch.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/furball|text=furball|quote=a small animal covered in fur, especially one that is nice to hold or touch|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20250526024420}}</ref>
*'''Fuzzball''': Derogatory term used by Han Solo to address [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].<ref name="ESB" />

==G==
*'''Gaggle of [[The Force/Legends|Force]] adepts''': A group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] as described by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="BTS" />
*'''Galactic!''': An exclamation of surprise and awe used by youth during the early years of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Similar to the real-world exclamation "(good) heavens."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/Good+heavens!|text=Good heavens!|quote=(good) heavens <small>A mild oath of surprise, exasperation, annoyance, frustration, or anger.</small>|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230505190646}}</ref>
*'''Galactic Drift''': One of [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] mystical expletives.<ref name="LCMS" />
*'''[[Galoomp/Legends|Galoomp]] chase''': A futile search.<ref name="Vortex" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "wild goose chase."<ref name="Goosey" />
*'''Gander''': [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|SpecOps]] slang for [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]].<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Gark''': SpecOps slang for any flying [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Gartal''': An [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] expletive.<ref name="TG" />
*'''Garthol's Pain''': A [[Human/Legends|Human]] expletive used when one was surprised.<ref name="Engagement">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
*'''Garvan's knees''': An exclamation.<ref name="Stock">{{WEGCite|story=There's No Such T'ing as a 'Stock' Light Freighter, Boy!|book=The Star Wars Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>
*'''[[Gas/Legends|Gas]]-gulper''': [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] used this term for the giant [[Neebray/Legends|neebray]] mantas.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>
*'''Gasgut''': Slang name for a [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]], used by [[W. Wald]] to describe [[Watto/Legends|Watto]].<ref name="SWG:AED" />
*'''The Gate''': [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] slang for [[Coyn]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located closest to the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''GBH''': SpecOps acronym for Gross [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty Hunter]], e.g. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88]], [[Zardra]] etc.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''G-burp''': [[Spacer/Legends|Spacer]] slang for a sudden surge from a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] drive system.<ref name="The Unseen Queen" />
*'''Geezer''': A disrespectful term for an elderly man.<ref name="SW4" /><ref name="DF:JK">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>
*'''Gentlebeing''': Version of "gentleman" used to describe a member of any [[Gender/Legends|gender]] and [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="LCFO" /> Real-world science fiction word.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.wordsense.eu/gentlebeing|text=gentlebeing|quote=(scifi, usually plural, sometimes, humorous) Polite term of address for any living being, human or otherwise.|work=WordSense|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/YUZpM}}</ref>
*'''Geos''': [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]].<ref name="BFTFTS" />
*'''Geosync''': Slang term for geosynchronous [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].<ref name="MJH" />
*'''Get the show on the road''': Slang phrase equivalent to "Let's get moving," as used by [[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]].<ref name="SW8" /> Real-world idiom.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/get-the-this-show-on-the-road|text=get the/this show on the road|quote=to begin an activity that has been planned|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230307060456}}</ref>
*'''Get your gills in a twist''': To become upset about something; used about a [[Mere]].<ref name="S:C2" /> Similar to the real world [[Wikipedia:British English|British English]] idiom "get your knickers in a twist."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/get-knickers-in-a-twist|text=get your knickers in a twist|quote='''''idiom''''' UK informal humorous '''to become confused, worried, or annoyed about something'''|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625170335}}</ref>
*'''Gfersh''': An adaptable expletive, likely [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] in origin, as in "What the ''gfersh'' is this?"<ref name="GG11">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref>
*'''[[Ghost (folklore)/Legends|Ghost]]''': Term for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] used by [[Lumiya|Shira Brie]].<ref name="SW 60" />
*'''Giants of Sand''': Term used by [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] to describe the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
*'''Gibbertz and ham''': Expletive used by [[Tup (thief)|Tup]], originated on [[Simpla-12]].<ref name="JA:TEE">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Evil Experiment]]''</ref>
*'''Gift for [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]]''': Used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents to indicate that a starship had been hijacked for use in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]].<ref name="SO:SJ">{{Journal|13|Special Ops: Ship Jackers}}</ref>
*'''Give a handful of snot''': To care about, as in "You think anybody on [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]] gives a handful of snot who rules on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]?".<ref name="SP" /> Similar to the rude real-world slang phrase "give a shit."<ref name="Give a">{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/give-a-shit|text=give a shit|quote=If someone says that they do not give a shit about something, they mean that they do not care about it at all. |work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20230625170711}}</ref>
*'''Give a [[Poodoo/Legends|poodoo]]''': To care about something, e.g. "Why give a poodoo?"<ref name="MF" /> Similar to the rude real-world slang phrase "give a shit."<ref name="Give a" />
*'''Give a [[Psadan|Psadan's]] patoot''': Phrase that meant "to care about something"; however, usually said as "didn't give" or "don't give a Psadan's patoot."<ref name="DS" /> Similar to the rude real-world slang phrase "give a shit."<ref name="Give a" />
*'''Give her the [[Blaster/Legends|gun]]''': Slang command meaning "Go as fast as possible."<ref name="SW7" />
*'''Glio svbas''': [[Ysannan/Legends|Ysannan]] phrase meaning "goodbye."<ref name="DEII6">[[Dark Empire II 6|''Dark Empire II'' 6]]</ref>
*'''[[Glit-biter]]''': [[Corellian Security Forces|CorSec]] slang for individuals addicted to the raw, unrefined form of [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]], a form of [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="Wedge's Gamble" /> Also spelled as '''glitbiter'''.<ref name="XKT" />
*'''Glitch-head''': An insult used by [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]].<ref name="aoi">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref>
*'''Glow stick''': Slang for [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="COD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>
*'''[[Gnat/Legends|Gnats]]''': Elrood sector slang for [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]].<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''Gnu''': SpecOps slang for [[Blaster/Legends|gun]] or [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]].<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Gnurled''': Expletive; e.g. "Where'd all the gnurled [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|bandits]] come from?"<ref name="Rogue Squadron 1" /> Similar to the real-world swear word "damn."
*'''Go bandit''': Slang for an AWOL [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] or unit, who deserted from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].
*'''Goggle-[[Eye/Legends|eyes]]''': A disrespectful term for a Rodian.<ref name="SotEPG">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>
*'''Goggle-eyed freaks''': An insult once used by [[Canderous Ordo]] in reference to [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatans]]. "Hold on a [[Standard second|second]] - you understood these goggle-eyed freaks?".<ref name="KOTOR" />
*'''Go kiss a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]''': Used to show a lack of respect for someone.<ref name="Jedi Search">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref> Similar to the vulgar real-world slang phrase "kiss my ass."
*'''Gone over the falls''': Another word for a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] overdose used by many [[Fringer/Legends|fringers]].<ref name="OKiss">{{LivingForce|Oblivion's Kiss}}</ref>
*'''Gonzo''': A Human word used by [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade]], apparently meaning cool or great.<ref name="Hnn-Senate Speeder Thief Arrested">{{Hnn|56|news/13516_5.html|Senate Speeder Thief Arrested}}</ref>
*'''Goo''': Slang for [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], to an [[IRD starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="HSSE" />
*'''Go to poodoo''': To go awry.<ref name="RC:TC" /><ref name="Blue Shadow Virus">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref> Similar to the real-world rude slang phrase "go to shit."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/go+to+shit|text=go to shit|quote=''rude slang'' To deteriorate or go awry.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625170938}}</ref>
*'''Grakh''': A [[Yuuzhan Vong]] expletive.<ref name="FH1" />
*'''[[Gravel-maggot|Gravel maggot]]''': Also, "'''Feed like a gravel maggot'''." Disparaging term in Mos Eisley for a person who takes advantage of others. Named for a native scavenger.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 7" />
*'''Grease''': Stormtrooper slang for "kill."<ref name="DF:SFTE" /> Also SpecOps slang for funding for bribes.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Grease bucket''': Insult for a [[Droid/Legends|droid]].<ref name="The White Witch">{{DroidsCite|The White Witch}}</ref>
*'''Grease the servos''' or '''grease the [[Servomotor/Legends|servomotors]]''': A phrase meaning "to bribe,"<ref name="SWRPG2" /> as of an official.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 7" /> Also SpecOps slang for funding for bribes.<ref name="GG9" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "grease someone's palm."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/grease-palm|text=grease someone's palm|quote=to secretly give someone money in order to persuade them to do something for you|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625171155}}</ref>
*'''Grease the whole [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]]''': An [[Agamar/Legends|Agamari]] phrase meaning to commit fully.<ref name="LOTF:B">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>
*'''Great Bantha''': An expression of shock or surprise.<ref name="JJF:KB">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: Kenobi's Blade]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world [[Wikipedia:American English|American English]] exclamation "great Scott."<ref name="Great Scott">{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/great-scott|text=Great Scott|quote='''in American English INTERJECTION''' a euphemistic interjection or oath, usually expressing surprise, amazement, or the like|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625171519}}</ref>
*'''Great Beyond''': A euphemism for the afterlife.<ref name="TFO">{{Journal|15|Two for One}}</ref>
*'''Great [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]''': An exclamation.<ref name="TBH:SW">''[[The Bounty Hunters: Scoundrel's Wages]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world [[Wikipedia:American English|American English]] exclamation "great Scott."<ref name="Great Scott" />
*'''Great [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]!''': An exclamation.<ref name="LCMS" /> Similar to the real-world [[Wikipedia:American English|American English]] exclamation "great Scott."<ref name="Great Scott" />
*'''Great gobs of [[Bantha fodder/Legends|bantha poodoo]]!''': An exclamation.<ref name="TPM novel">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref><ref name="Cuss" /> Similar to the rude real-world exclamation "holy shit."
*'''Great [[Deity/Legends|gods]] of the [[Water/Legends|waters]]''': Exclamation used by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Cha Niathal]].<ref name="rev" /> Similar to the real-world [[Wikipedia:American English|American English]] exclamation "great Scott."<ref name="Great Scott" />
*'''Great Vacuum''': A euphemism for [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="HL">{{WEGCite|book=Instant Adventures|story=Heavy Lifting}}</ref>
*'''Great waves''': An exclamation<ref name="aoi" /> Similar to the real-world [[Wikipedia:American English|American English]] exclamation "great Scott."<ref name="Great Scott" />
*'''[[Color/Legends|Green]] as [[goblin moss]]''': Naïve, inexperienced.<ref name="Empire 9">[[Empire 9|''Empire'' 9]]</ref> Similar to the real-world [[Wikipedia:British English|British English]] idiom "green as grass."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/green-as-grass|text=green as grass|quote=[British] completely inexperienced or naive|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230701192726}}</ref>
*'''Greenhorn''': SpecOps slang for a new [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] soldier who is overly eager for combat.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Greenie''': A derogatory term for [[Mimbanite]]s<ref name="SME">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref> or Rodians;<ref name="KOTOR" /><ref name="Vassilika 5">[[Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika 5|''Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika'' 5]]</ref> also SpecOps slang for Rodians.<ref name="GG9" /> Also a term for inexperienced [[Scout/Legends|scouts]].<ref name="TRG-Scout">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]&mdash;Laconic Scout template</ref>
*'''Grey man''': SpecOps slang for an [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|Agent]].<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Grife''': An expression of relief.<ref name="JK:JA">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>
*'''Grist''': An expletive used by [[Nym/Legends|Nym]].<ref name="S:C1">[[Starfighter: Crossbones 1|''Starfighter: Crossbones'' 1]]</ref>
*'''Gronk''': SpecOps slang for any species capable of uttering a particularly loud cry/alarm call, as in "gronk!"<ref name="GG9" />
*'''[[Grubber]]''': Slang term to refer to an individual of ill repute.<ref name="SW56">[[Star Wars (1977) 56|''Star Wars'' (1977) 56]]</ref>
*'''Gruff''': SpecOps slang for any canine-looking species.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Grunts''': Derisive Elrood sector slang for [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]].<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''Guest''': Elrood sector slang for someone taking refuge on [[Kidron/Legends|Kidron]].<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''GS''': Groundshaker. SpecOps term for an Imperial AT-AT walker.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''[[Gullipud]]''': Slang for a scared individual,<ref name="SWL2">[[Legacy (2006) 2|''Legacy'' (2006) 2]]</ref> similar to the real-world noun "fraidy-cat."<ref name="Fraidy-cat" />
*'''GUB''': Great Uncle Boba. Referring to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="GG9" />
*'''[[Gundark/Legends|Gundark]] droppings''': Something of bad quality.<ref name="Rogue Squadron ½">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron ½|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' ½]]</ref> Similar to the real-world nouns shit and bullshit.
*'''A [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan's]] [[Ear/Legends|ears]]''': A large amount, as in "I'm a Gungan's ears better than the alternative."<ref name="TopWorld">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: TopWorld}}</ref>
*'''Gunnery seat''': A term for the front passenger seat of a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]]. It could be shouted before entering the vehicle in order to claim the seat.<ref name="LOS">{{InsiderCite|73|The League of Spies}}</ref> Similar to the real-world term "shotgun" (as in "calling shotgun").<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/shotgun|text=shotgun|quote=used to refer to the seat next to the driver in a car or other vehicle: (...) ''Has anyone called shotgun? If not, I do!''|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230703110224}}</ref>

==H==
*'''Haar'chak''': [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]] expletive,<ref name="KOTOR26">[[Knights of the Old Republic 26|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 26]]</ref><ref name="Legacy 41" /> translating as "damn it".<ref name="Legacy glossary 2">''[[Star Wars Legends Epic Collection: Legacy Vol. 2]]'' alien language glossary</ref>
*'''[[Hair/Legends|Hair]] shirt''': Used by [[Warto]] to refer to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].<ref name="SW8" />
*'''Haja''': Used as both a curse and expression of delight among the nomadic [[Alwari]] of [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]; "'''jaja'''" was the [[Gwurran]] equivalent.<ref name="TAS" />
*'''Hammered''': To undergo a heavy attack.<ref name="VOTF" /> Real-world term.
*'''[[Hammerhead/Legends|Hammerheads]]''': Nickname for [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]];<ref name="Play it Again">{{StoryCite|story=Play It Again, Figrin D'an: The Tale of Muftak and Kabe|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> also [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|SpecOps]] slang for the same [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="GG9" />'''
*'''Hapan fleet''': A well-equipped and disciplined command of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] which had yet to see action in the field; the term was used among Imperials deriding the [[Hapan Royal Navy]].<ref name="TEA" />
*'''Happy juice''': An [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic beverage]].<ref name="Empire 8" />
*'''Happy landings''': An old [[Spacer/Legends|spacer's]] greeting.<ref name="HSRevenge" />
*'''Hard contact''': Term used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to describe a physical engagement with a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] being.<ref name="RC:HC" />
*'''Hard merchandise''': [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] phrase given to the subject upon which a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] has been placed.<ref name="Hard Merchandise">''[[Hard Merchandise]]''</ref>
*'''Hard-shell [[Human/Legends|Humans]]''': [[Mimbanite]] slang for [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial stormtroopers]].<ref name="SME" />
*'''Harpy''': A derogatory term applied to a [[Gender/Legends|female]]; [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] referred to [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] as a [[Hair/Legends|hairless]] one.<ref name="Cloak of Darkness">{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness}}</ref>
*'''Hatch persuader''': [[Darman Skirata|Darman's]] term to describe a [[magnetic frame charge]].<ref name="RC:TZ" />
*'''Haul jets''': Spacer slang for departing an area as fast as possible.<ref name="SWGMSR" /><ref name="SWRPG2" />
*'''Have one's fingers in many [[Stew/Legends|stewpots]]''': Have a large number of connections.<ref name="VOTF" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "have a finger in every pie."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/have-a-finger-in-every-pie|text=have a finger in every pie|quote=to be involved in and have influence over many different activities, often in a way that people do not approve of|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625161259}}</ref>
*'''Have you gone spacesick?''': [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] expression.<ref name="Tempest" /><ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>
*'''Headhunting''': SpecOps slang for locating an enemy's primary nerve center with the intent to destroy it.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Headshot''': SpecOps slang for an operation which renders the rest of an enemy's operations completely useless.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Healing juice''': Phrase used to describe [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] or [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]]. Used by [[Jolee Bindo]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
*'''Heap of [[Bantha dung/Legends|bantha dung]]''': An insult.<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world offensive idiom "pile of shit."<ref name="Pile of shit" />
*'''Heaven''': A place of joy and rest, e.g. "a glutton's heaven"<ref name="POT" /> or "'''falling down a hole into heaven'''", a phrase used among [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]]s to refer to the pleasant experience that came with using a high quality interface link.<ref name="Tyrant">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref> Real-world noun.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/heaven|text=heaven|quote=a situation that gives you great pleasure: |work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625161451}}</ref>
*'''Heavenly hutches''': An interjection used by [[Lepi/Legends|Lepi]].<ref name="SW10" />
*'''Heck''': Mild expletive.<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref> Real-world exclamation.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/heck|text=heck|quote=an expression of usually slight anger or surprise, or a way of adding force to a statement, question, etc|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625161719}}</ref>
*'''Heel-and-toe express''': Slang for a long walk, march or run.<ref name="HSLL" />
*'''[[Chaos/Legends|Hell]]''': Expletive; could also be modified with intensifiers, for example; "What the hell are you doing"<ref name="ANH" /> or "Where in eight [[Stalbringion hells]] did that come from?"<ref name="LSSM" /> Real-world swear word.
*'''Helping the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor]]''': [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] slang for someone who has been arrested by the Empire and forced to work in the mines of [[Imperial Mining, Ltd.|Imperial Mining]].<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''Hibernation''': Slang for time that [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Computer/Legends|computers]] rest.<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
*'''High-Altitude''': [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] slang for undercover.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />
*'''High-band transmission''': Any transmission at high, very high, ultrahigh or superhigh frequencies.<ref name="GTSWU1" />
*'''High numbers''': A slang for "advantage," as in the phrase "He has all the high numbers&hellip;" used by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]; probably a term originating from [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]].<ref name="SW7" />
*'''Hijack''': SpecOps slang for getting a complete stranger to render assistance, via trickery, bribing, persuasion etc.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''His Imperial Travesty''': Elrood sector slang for [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''Hitching a ride''': SpecOps slang for using someone else's intelligence facilities or network, usually without their knowledge or permission.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Hits off the Cosmic Deck''': Fate and playing the cards one was dealt.<ref name="HSSE" />
*'''Home is where you lay your head''': Rebel saying.<ref name="DF:SFTE" /> Similar to the real-world proverb "home is where the heart is."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/home+is+where+the+heart+is|text=home is where the heart is |quote=''proverb'' One's home is made up of the places and people one loves or cherishes most.|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230531202523}}</ref>
*'''Hold your [[Dewback/Legends|dewbacks]]''': Used to tell someone to wait, slow down.<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world idiom "hold your horses."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/hold-horses|text=hold your horses|quote=used to tell someone to stop and consider carefully their decision or opinion about something|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625162405}}</ref>
*'''[[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] bimbo''' or '''Holo-bim''': Slang for a less-than-ladylike female celebrity. Used to describe [[Yara Grugara]].<ref name="CSWE" />
*'''Holy [[beek-monkey]]s!''': An interjection used by Han Solo.<ref name="SW10" /> Similar to the real-world term "holy catfish/cow/cricket/mackerel."<ref name="Oh so holy">{{WebCite|url=https://www.phrases.com/psearch/holy%20cow|text=Phrases related to: holy cow|quote='''holy cow''' An exclamation of surprise or astonishment. (...) '''holy cricket''' In shock, terrified, etc. (...) '''holy mackerel''' An expression of surprise. (...) '''holy catfish''' Expression of terror, awe, surprise, astonishment, etc.|work=Phrases.com|archivedate=20230422220815}}</ref>
*'''Holy [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]!''': An exclamation.<ref name="Marooned">{{Tales|22|Marooned}}</ref> Similar to the real-world term "holy catfish/cow/cricket/mackerel."<ref name="Oh so holy" />
*'''Holy [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of [[Meteor/Legends|meteors]]''': Interjection used by Han Solo.<ref name="BTS" /> Similar to the real-world interjection "holy mother of God."<ref name="Holy mother">{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/Holy+Mother+of+God|text=(Holy) Mother of God|quote=An exclamation of alarm, amazement, or exasperation. (Could be considered blasphemous to some.)|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230623224045}}</ref>
*'''Holy milking [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]!''': [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] exclamation.<ref name="MJH" /> Similar to the real-world rude slang exclamation "holy shit."
*'''Holy Sith!''': An interjection.<ref name="SWGB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref><ref name="PaxEmpirica">{{StoryCite|story=Pax Empirica&mdash;The Wookiee Annihilation|book=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> A pun on the real-world rude slang exclamation "holy shit."
*'''Home free''': A term meaning "safe," used by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="SW4" /> "Be home free" is a real-world [[Wikipedia:American English|American English]] idiom meaning to have finished the hardest part of something and is therefore likely sure to succeed.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/be-home-free|text=be home free|quote=<small>US informal</small> to be certain to succeed at something because you have done the most difficult part of it:|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20220905161130}}</ref>
*'''Home sweet home''': A phrase Han Solo used to refer to places at which he had stayed, such as [[Aduba-3/Legends|Aduba-3]].<ref name="SW11" /> Real-world idiom.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/home%20sweet%20home|text=home sweet home|quote=used when one returns home after being away to say that one is happy to be home|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20230420123859}}</ref>
*'''Honest to Entropy!''': An exclamation.<ref name="LCMS" />
*'''Hoodoo''': Used by [[Jariah Syn]] to refer to [[Cade Skywalker|Cade Skywalker's]] [[Force power]]s.<ref name="Legacy 15" /> Real-world noun.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/hoodoo|text=hoodoo|quote=a magical or mysterious power over other people|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625163033}}</ref>
*'''Hook up a [[Power coupling/Legends|power coupling]]''' (or '''hook up a power conduit'''): Slang for [[Reproduction/Legends|sexual intercourse]].<ref name="KOTOR2" />
*'''Hoo-man''' (or '''Hoo-mie'''): [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] slang for Humans.<ref name="SotEPG" />
*'''Hooted like a cloud ape''': A phrase used to refer to speech that was melodic or rhythmic.<ref name="Prize Pelt">{{StoryCite|story=The Prize Pelt: The Tale of Bossk|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>
*'''Hornhead''': A derogatory term for a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]].<ref name="Hornhead">{{CSWECite|II|60|hornhead}}</ref>
*'''Hot wash-up''': Grand Army of the Republic military slang for a briefing in which the failures of a mission are reviewed.<ref name="RC:TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>
*'''How do you plot that course?''': A phrase meaning "How did you come to that conclusion?"<ref name="DT1">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref>
*'''How in blazes''': An intensifier.<ref name="VOTF" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "how in hell".
*'''How in space...''': An explanation of surprise.<ref name="VOTF" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "how in the world..."
*'''How the [[Kriff/Legends|kriff]]''': Intensifier used to express surprise, e.g. "How the kriff did you manage that?".<ref name="Allies" /> Since "kriff" is believed to be the ''Star Wars'' equivalent of the real-world swear-word "f*ck",<ref name="SW.com">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=243200&start=360#15784824|thread=The Official Abel G. Peña Thread (Halagad Approved)|user=[[Abel G. Peña|Halagad]]|date=2006-10-13|time=6:19 PM|quote=I think Tim Zahn just reversed the k and f on the popular F-bomb substitute "frikkin."}}</ref> "how the kriff" would be similar to the real-world phrase "how the f*ck".
*'''How the [[Stang/Legends|stang]]''': Intensifier used to express surprise, e.g. "How the stang did you access ''that''?".<ref name="O66" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "how the hell."
*'''Hrai!''': A [[Morgukai]] equivalent of a laugh.<ref name="Republic 74">[[Republic 74|''Republic'' 74]]</ref>
*'''HSS''': SpecOps acronym for High Speed Surgery, referring to the act of disabling an armored vehicle or [[Starship/Legends|starship]] by cutting a hole in the hull and injecting a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] or [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]].<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Hufgeb Hsicl Merht''': Expletive phrase used by [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]].<ref name="Void IV" />
*'''Huk''': A slur used by the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]], meaning "soulless bug," which was used to describe a [[Yam'rii/Legends|Yam'rii]].<ref name="US">{{InsiderCite|86|Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous}}</ref>
*'''Hundred club''': SpecOps slang for people with bounties on them that exceed 100,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and are still free.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Hunting [[shoal darter]]s''': Slang for extensively searching for something that may not be there.<ref name="Specter of the Past" /> Equivalent to the real-world phrase "wild goose chase."
*'''Hurt vector''': Slang for a person who seems to attract misfortune to themselves as well as others around them.<ref name="HSLL" />
*'''Hutt slime!''': A curse.<ref name="DJ">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world rude exclamation "bullshit."
*'''[[Huttspit]]''': A curse in the [[Ciutric Hegemony]].<ref name="XIR">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world rude exclamation "bullshit."
*'''Huttwash''': An expletive used for disbelief in a statement made by someone else.<ref name="The Swarm War" /> Similar to the real-world noun "hogwash."<ref name="Hogwash">{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/hogwash|text=hogwash|quote=If you describe what someone says as hogwash, you think it is nonsense.|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20221005215654}}</ref>
*'''Hut'uun''': Mando'a curse for "coward."<ref name="SWRC" />
*'''Hyperspace commo''': Slang for faster-than-light communication.<ref name="HSSE" />

==I==
*'''Idiot thrift''': Slang for the act of scavenging.<ref name="TMA">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>
*'''IED''': Abbreviation for Improvised Explosive Device.<ref name="RC:HC" /> Real-world term.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/ied|text=IED|quote=abbreviation for improvised explosive device: a type of bomb made and used by people who are not members of an official army, etc.|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20220503092659}}</ref>
*'''I'll be broggled''': An exclamation of surprise.<ref name="OF" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "I'll be damned."<ref name="Damned">{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/well-i-ll-be-damned|text=(well) I'll be damned!|quote=an expression of complete surprise|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230625155620}}</ref>
*'''I'll be [[Kessel/Legends|Kesseled]]''': Exclamation of surprise.<ref name="VOTF" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "I'll be damned."<ref name="Damned" />
*'''I'll bet the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Falcon]]''''': A phrase once used by Han Solo, meaning to be extraordinarily certain of something that you'd figuratively be willing to gamble something you cared about &mdash; in his case, the ''Millennium Falcon''.<ref name="Specter of the Past" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "I'd bet money".<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/I%27d+bet+money|text=I'd bet money|quote=I'm so confident that I am right (or that you are wrong) that I'm willing to bet on it.|work=https://www.thefreedictionary.com/|archivedate=20240314021553}}</ref>
*'''I'll see you in [[Chaos/Legends|Hell]]!''': An exclamation.<ref name="ESB" /><ref name="BH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> Real-world phrase.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/I%27ll+see+you+in+hell|text=(I'll) see you in hell!|quote=A curse laid upon someone, especially when parting.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230423204804}}</ref>
*'''Imperialist''': A term for [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] that supported [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CSWE" />
*'''Imperial dirty tricks team''': Term for an Imperial Intelligence strike team once used by [[Moranda Savich]].<ref name="VOTF" />
*'''Impies''': Slang term for Imperials.<ref name="TRG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
*'''Imps''': Slang and ironic term for Imperials ([[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], [[TIE pilot]]s etc.).<ref name="XBW" />
*'''Impstar Deuce''': Slang term often used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]]/[[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] pilots when referring to an [[ Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer Mark II]].<ref name="XBW" />
*'''In big doo-doo''': [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] slang for being in serious trouble.<ref name="TPM" /> Similar to the real-world vulgar phrase "in deep shit."<ref name="In deep shit">{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/in-the-shit-in-deep-shit|text=in the shit/in deep shit|quote=If someone is in the shit or in deep shit, they are in a lot of trouble.|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230423205455}}</ref>
*'''In deep [[Bantha dung/Legends|bantha dung]]''': To be in a lot of trouble.<ref name="Jedi Search" /> Similar to the real-world vulgar phrase "in deep shit."<ref name="In deep shit" />
*'''In deep [[Poodoo/Legends|poodoo]]''': Being in a lot of trouble.<ref name="Stealth" /> Similar to the real-world vulgar phrase "in deep shit."<ref name="In deep shit" />
*'''In humpty deep poodoo''': [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] term for being in a lot of trouble.<ref name="Patterns">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world vulgar phrase "in deep shit."<ref name="In deep shit" />
*'''In deep [[mopak]]''': To be in deep trouble.<ref name="TAS" /> Similar to the real-world vulgar phrase "in deep shit."<ref name="In deep shit" />
*'''In [[Malachor V|Malachor]]''': Used to make a statement more forceful, as in "There is no way in Malachor that I'm going to lead this pitiful squad."<ref name="CWMIA" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "in Hell," e.g. "There is no way in Hell I'm going!".<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/in%20hell|text=in hell|quote=used to make a statement or question more forceful ''There is no way in hell I'm going!''|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20230620142804}}</ref>
*'''[[Insect/Legends|Insect]]''': A contemptible person.<ref name="SWR" /> Real-world noun.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/insect|text=insect|quote='''2 :''' a trivial or contemptible person|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20240317214823}}</ref>
*'''Interesting''': [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|SpecOps]] term for Very Dangerous.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''In the poodoo''': To be in deep trouble.<ref name="rev" /> Similar to the offensive real-world [[Wikipedia:British English|British English]] idiom "in the shit."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/in%20the%20shit|text=in the shit|quote='''British, informal + offensive''': in a lot of trouble|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20230602194039}}</ref>
*'''In the Name''': Exclamation.<ref name="LCFO" />Similar to the real-world idiom "in the name of God/heaven."<ref name="In the name of">{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/in+the+name+of+God|text=in the name of God |quote='''in the name of God''' (...) A phrase of exasperation used to emphasize a question or statement. (...) '''in the name of heaven''' A phrase of exasperation used to emphasize a question.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230701164602}}</ref>
*'''In the name of&hellip;!''': An exclamation.<ref name="LCFO" /><ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Similar to the real-world idiom "in the name of God/heaven."<ref name="In the name of" />
*'''In the name of [[Chaos/Legends|Chaos]]''': An exclamation.<ref name="LCMS" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "in the name of heaven."<ref name="In the name of" />
*'''In the name of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]]&hellip;''': See '''in the name of Chaos'''.<ref name="LCMS" /><ref name="LCSTB" />
*'''In the name of the Edge, the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]], and everything in between''': One of Lando Calrissian's mystical expletives; see '''in the name of Chaos'''.<ref name="LCSTB" />
*'''In the name of the Eternal''': Expletive used by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Bassi Vobah]]; see '''in the name of Chaos'''.<ref name="LCFO" />
*'''In the name of the [[Galactic Center]]''': Another one of Lando Calrissian's mystical expletives; see '''in the name of Chaos'''.<ref name="LCMS" />
*'''In the name of the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galactic]] Drift''': Yet another one of Lando Calrissian's mystical expletives; see '''in the name of Chaos'''.<ref name="LCMS" />
*'''In the name of the herds of [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]]''': Used by the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Umwaw Moolis]] to emphasize welcome.<ref name="COTJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref> Similar to the real-world idiom "in the name of heaven."<ref name="In the name of" />
*'''In the skin and twice as pompous''': A phrase once used by [[Klif]], meaning to see someone in-person.<ref name="VOTF" /> "In the skin" is similar to the real-world phrase "in the flesh".<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/in-the-flesh|text=in the flesh|quote=in real life, and not on TV, in a movie, in a picture, etc.|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20210506123225}}</ref>
*'''Into the [[Nexu/Legends|nexu's]] den''': Into a strongly defended area.<ref name="DS" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "the lion's den," referring to a dangerous place or situation.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/lion-s-den|text=into the lion's den|quote=a dangerous or threatening place or situation|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230621210855}}</ref>
*'''Ion surprise''': A [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] term used to describe a surprise appearance of ion weapons in a battle.<ref name="Ion surprise">{{CSWECite|II|113|ion surprise}}</ref>
*'''Ish'ka''': A [[Yuuzhan Vong]] expletive, used to indicate one's displeasure with a situation.<ref name="FH3">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic III: Reunion]]''</ref>
*'''ISD''': An [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]].<ref name="LOTF:E" />

==J==
*'''[[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]]''': A slang verb meaning "to deceive someone, leaving them in danger."<ref name="SWRPG2" />
*'''Jactna''': A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] expletive.<ref name="Hovel">{{Tales|6|The Hovel on Terk Street}}</ref>
*'''Jaja''': The [[Gwurran]] equivalent of "'''haja'''"—used as both a curse and expression of delight.<ref name="TAS" />
*'''Jango's [[Bone/Legends|bones]]!''': An exclamation used by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], referring to their genetic source [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="ROF">''[[Reversal of Fortune]]''</ref>
*'''[[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] juice''': A nickname for<ref name="AOTC" /> the [[Ardees/Legends|Ardees]] beverage.<ref name="AOTC novel">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>
*'''Jawa-''': In [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], open comparisons to Jawas often refer to dishonesty; e.g., "Jawa ''trader''."<ref name="Galaxy Guide 7" />
*'''Jawa trader''': Mos Eisley slang for anyone who isn't honest, or trades in stolen or badly damaged goods.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 7" />
*'''Jaw-wag''': Idle rumors or gossip.<ref name="CSWE" />
*'''[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] scum/slime''': Derogatory term for Jedi.<ref name="ROTS" />
*'''''[[Jeedai]]''''': Alternate word for Jedi, used by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]<ref name="Rebirth">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref> and some other people, like the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Bok]] and [[Tyr]],<ref name="SW44" /> and the Rodian [[Dejarro]].<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> Also the [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] word for Jedi.<ref name="GPBTG" />
*'''Jerk-ass''': Expletive referring to a largely unpleasant or unbearable individual.<ref name="Star Wars: Behind the Magic">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> Real-world slang.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.wordsense.eu/jerk-ass|text=jerk-ass|quote=''Alternative form of jerkass'' (...) '''jerkass''' (''pl.'' '''jerkasses''') 1. ''(slang, pejorative)'' An obnoxious or unlikeable person; a jerk.|work=WordSense|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/e3KhO}}</ref>
*'''Jet Juicer''': An [[Alcohol|/Legends|alcoholic]].<ref name="HSLL" />
*'''Jillie''': The [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Grees]] referred to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] as a "heartless jillie."<ref name="TG" />
*'''[[Jinda/Legends|Jinda]]''': A condescending nickname used by village-dwelling [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] to insult nomadic Ewoks, comparing their habits to those of the Jinda [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="COE">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/feature20081201.html|text=Castaways of Endor|int=Castaways of Endor}}</ref>
*'''Jink''': An expletive; the rough equivalent of "b*stard" or "wise-ass." Control used this to describe Luke Skywalker ("Hensing there really despises sarcastic jinks").<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>
*'''Jobber''': [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] slang for an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]].<ref name="Jobber">{{CSWECite|II|169|jobber}}</ref>
*'''Jookley''': An adjective meaning roughly "over-the top" or "ridiculous." [[Lorz Geptun]] used this to describe a uniform he wore.<ref name="LSSM" />
*'''Juggy''': Military jargon for [[juggernaut]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
*'''Jumped-up [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] dirt [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]]''': An insult.<ref name="DJ" />
*'''Junior''': A condescending form of address [[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]] used when speaking to enemies such as [[Warto]] and the [[Behemoth from the World Below]].<ref name="SW10" /> Real-world noun for a young person.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/junior|text=junior|quote= (3): a young person|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20230624224919}}</ref>
*'''Junker''': [[Fleet Command (New Republic)/Legends|Fleet Office]] slang for a fleet hauler that had been used for data collecting,<ref name="BTS" /> also a term used for settlers on [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] after the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|Battle of Ruusan]]<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|181|Junker}}</ref>
*'''Juvie-gang''': Slang for a group of juveniles engaged in criminal activity.<ref name="HSLL" />

==K==
*'''Kanabar''': Used by members of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[worker caste]] to refer to one of their peers.<ref name="NJOSB">''[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]''</ref>
*'''Kane a bar''': An insult translating from the [[Yuuzhan Vong (language)|Yuuzhan Vong language]] as "dung of a meat maggot"; a play on the Yuuzhan Vong word '''kanabar'''.<ref name="Star by Star" />
*'''Kanushka''': A [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] expletive.<ref name="MBS" />
*'''[[Kark/Legends|Kark]]''': Derogatory expletive.<ref name="Legacy glossary 3" />
*'''[[Katchni]]''': An insult.<ref name="VOTF" />
*'''[[Kath hound/Legends|Kath hound]]''': A coward, e.g. "You want to slink away like a kath hound banished from its pack."<ref name="Rule of Two" />
*'''Kath-mutt''': An insult.<ref name="Path of Destruction" />
*'''Kath pup''': A coward; e.g. "Hide in the bushes like a scared little kath pup."<ref name="Dynasty of Evil">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>
*'''Kerko''': Slang term for [[Kerkoiden/Legends|Kerkoidens]].<ref name="TCW novel">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref>
*'''Kick-ass''': Slang term for cool or interesting.<ref name="Star Wars: Behind the Magic" /> Real-world adjective.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/kick-ass|text=kick-ass|quote=very exciting or forceful|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230624215811}}</ref>
*'''Kick-the-[[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]''': Slang in [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] court for a stupid stunt where the gain is not proportioned to the risks.<ref name="VOTF" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "poke the bear."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/poke-the-bear|text=poke the bear|quote=to intentionally make or try to make someone angry or offended, especially someone more powerful than you|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20250529065534}}</ref>
*'''Kill two [[Bird/Legends|birds]] with one stone''': A term that means to finish two objectives in one move.<ref name="Duels Prima">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Lightsaber Duels: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Lightsaber Duels'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> Real-world idiom.<ref name="Birds stone">{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/kill-two-birds-with-one-stone|text=kill two birds with one stone|quote=to succeed in achieving two things in a single action|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230624220308}}</ref>
*'''[[King/Legends|King]]-size''': An adjective meaning "very large," used by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to describe [[sea-dragon]]s.<ref name="SW11" /> Real-world adjective.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/king-size|text=king-size|quote=If something is king-size or king-sized, it is larger than the ordinary size|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230624220439}}</ref>
*'''Kingdom-come''': A term for the location where something that has been destroyed goes.<ref name="SW6" /> Real-world noun.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/kingdom-come|text=kingdom come|quote=1. the next world; life after death|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230624220749}}</ref>
*'''Kiss my [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]''': Non-canon phrase used to show disagreement.<ref name="Skreej">{{Tales|10|Skreej}}</ref> A parody of the vulgar real-world slang phrase "kiss my ass."
*'''Kiss my [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]''': Used to show a lack of respect for someone.<ref name="Courtship">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> Similar to the vulgar real-world slang phrase "kiss my ass."
*'''Klick''': Slang term for [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]].<ref name="XIR" /> Real-world slang.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/klick|text=klick|quote='''slang''' kilometer|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20230624221021}}</ref>
*'''Koochoo''' or '''koochu''': [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] for "idiot."<ref name="GPBTG" />
*'''Knocked a few bolts loose in your [[Brain/Legends|brain]]-case''': To be out of one's mind.<ref name="Legacy 26">[[Legacy (2006) 26|''Legacy'' (2006) 26]]</ref>
*'''Knocking on the Roof''': [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|Orbital bombardment]] on [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]].<ref name="RB" />
*'''[[Koovy]]''': [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] term for something cool and groovy.<ref name="R:R">''[[Rookies: Rendezvous]]''</ref>
*'''Krazsch''': An expletive used by the [[Riileb (species)|Riileb]] people.<ref name="Rendezvous with Destiny">{{Journal|6|Rendezvous with Destiny}}</ref>
*'''[[Kreetle]]''': An insult.<ref name="Tempest" />
*'''[[Kriff/Legends|Kriff]]''': An expletive.<ref name="Wild Space" /> Since "kriffing" is believed to be the ''Star Wars'' version of "f*cking,"<ref name="SW.com" /> "kriff" would be the ''Star Wars'' equivalent of the swear word "f*ck."
*'''Kriffing''': A derogatory modifier version of "kriff".<ref name="VOTF" /> It is believed that [[Timothy Zahn]] created the word by reversing the "f" and the "k" from the term "fricking," which is a synonym of real-world swear-word f*cking.<ref name="SW.com" />
*'''The kriff you did''': Used to tell someone that you didn't believe something that they said to you.<ref name="Abyss" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "the hell someone is/does."
*'''Kriff it''': Used for showing anger with something, e.g. "new [[Planet/Legends|planets]] were ''supposed'' to be romantic, kriff it."<ref name="Stealth" /> Since "kriffing" is believed to be the ''Star Wars'' version of "f*cking,"<ref name="SW.com" /> "kriff it" would be the ''Star Wars'' equivalent of "f*ck it."
*'''Krop''': Exclamation.<ref name="SWL2" />
*'''Krozit''': A [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] expletive.<ref name="SW44">[[Star Wars (1998) 44|''Star Wars'' (1998) 44]]</ref>
*'''KSA''': Kinky Silver Armor. A SpecOps term for an Imperial [[Radiation zone assault trooper|radtrooper]].<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Ktah''': A rare [[Cheunh/Legends|Cheunh]] curse.<ref name="FH2">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref> Reserved for intense or unusual situations due to the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]]' non-emotional nature.
*'''Kung''': A [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] insult (or compliment) translating as "scum," as in "U kulle rah doe kankee kung," meaning "You are my kind of scum."<ref name="ROTJ" />
*'''Kvark''': An [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] expletive.<ref name="Asha">{{Ewoks|Asha (episode)}}</ref>
*'''Kwagg''': Expletive used by [[Morag]].<ref name="Ewoks 8">[[Ewoks (1985) 8|''Ewoks'' (1985) 8]]</ref>
*'''Kwee-kunee''': [[King/Legends|Queen]].<ref name="Legacy glossary 3" />

==L==
*'''Law book''': [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] slang for [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], referring to people who take the law into their own hands by using it. Also '''rulebook'''.<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''LA-LAs''': [[Gallisport]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] slang. Nickname for the [[Legally Authorized Law Authorities]] that policed the [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="SG" />
*'''Larty''': [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|GAR]] slang for [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] gunships.<ref name="RC:TZ" />
*'''[[Laserbrain/Legends|Laserbrain]]''': An insult, e.g. "I don't know where you get your delusions, laserbrain."<ref name="ESB" /> Similar to the real-world noun "birdbrain."<ref name="Birdbrain" />
*'''Last trip home''': [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] slang for dying, following the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]].<ref name="Rogue Squadron 31">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 31|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 31]]</ref>
*'''Leaping [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]]''': An admirative exclamation.<ref name="ELAC">''[[Star Wars: Early Learning Activity Center]]''</ref>
*'''Leaping [[Luterian Lizard]]-lickers''': An admirative exclamation.<ref name="YCAC">''[[Star Wars: Yoda's Challenge Activity Center]]''</ref>
*'''LED''': Acronym for "light-emitting diode."<ref name="GTSWU1" /> Real-world terminology.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/dictionary/LED|text=LED|quote=a device that lights up and displays information when electricity passes through it ◊ LEDs are often used to show numbers and words on electronic devices such as digital clocks. LED is an abbreviation of "light-emitting diode."|work=''The [[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|Britannica]] Dictionary''|archivedate=20230624150345}}</ref>
*'''[[Lightfight]]''': Slang term for a fight involving blasters.<ref name="XRS" />
*'''Lies like a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]]''': Phrase implying the subject lies numerously and terribly.<ref name="Tale Crumb">{{StoryCite|story=That's Entertainment: The Tale of Salacious Crumb|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> Similar to the real-world [[Wikipedia:American English|American English]] idiom "lie like a rug," meaning to lie constantly.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/lie%20like%20a%20rug|text=lie like a rug|quote='''US, informal''': to lie constantly: to be dishonest|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20230519045753}}</ref>
*'''Life's a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]]''': [[Bithuband]] tagline.<ref name="Bithu">{{HoloNetNewsAd|url=meta/img/ads/468_10.gif|text=Life's a Bith}}</ref> A pun on the real-world idiom "life's a bitch (and then you die)."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/life-s-a-bitch-and-then-you-die|text=life's a bitch (and then you die)|quote=said when you find a situation difficult or have had a bad experience|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230624151539}}</ref>
*'''Lift vector''': Vector force exerted by a vehicle to counteract [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]].<ref name="GTSWU1" />
*'''Lighter''': [[Gallisport]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] slang. A [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]].<ref name="SG" />
*'''Lightfoot''': Armor crew term for infantry attached to tank units.<ref name="RB" />
*'''Like a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] at an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] roast''': A phrase used by [[Moranda Savich]], referring to something visibly appearing out of place.<ref name="VOTF" /> Similar to the real-world idioms "like a fish out of water"<ref name="Fish out of water">{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/like-a-fish-out-of-water|text=like a fish out of water|quote=If you feel like a fish out of water, you do not feel comfortable or relaxed because you are in an unusual or unfamiliar situation.|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/gb4Ki}}</ref> and "stand/stick out like a sore thumb."<ref name="Sore thumb">{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/stand-stick-out-like-a-sore-thumb|text=stand/stick out like a sore thumb|quote=If someone or something stands/sticks out like a sore thumb, everyone notices them because they are very different from the people or things around them|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20250715215726}}</ref>
*'''Like a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] at a [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] family reunion''': Something visibly appearing out of place; alternate version of the phrase "like a stormtrooper at an Ewok roast."<ref name="VOTF" /> Similar to the real-world idioms "like a fish out of water"<ref name="Fish out of water" /> and "stand/stick out like a sore thumb."<ref name="Sore thumb" />
*'''Like [[chubba]]''': Certainly not.<ref name="Omen" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "like hell."
*'''Like [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] on [[Mrlssi|Mrlssti]]''': An old [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani]] saying that highlights the comical size comparison between the two [[Species/Legends|species]]; referring to something visibly out of place.<ref name="Lords of the Expanse">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world idioms "like a fish out of water"<ref name="Fish out of water" /> and "stand/stick out like a sore thumb."<ref name="Sore thumb" />
*'''Like shooting [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Cals]] in a [[Fish/Legends|fish]] bowl''': [[Deal-slang]] for making many easy big deals from less than intelligent clients.<ref name="Gambler's Life" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "like shooting fish in a barrell," meaning "extremely easy."<ref name="Fish barrel" />
*'''[[The Link]]''': Elrood sector slang for an informal sector-wide network of gossipers that passed secrets and rumors throughout the sector.<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''Lint-[[Nerf/Legends|Nerf]]''': Slang term for a large dust-ball, used around [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].<ref name="XKT" />
*'''Little [[Gemstone/Legends|gem]]''': [[Nomi Sunrider|Nomi Sunrider's]] nickname for her little daughter, [[Vima Sunrider|Vima]].<ref name="Tales audio">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>
*'''Little [[Poodoo/Legends|poodoo]]''': An insult.<ref name="Stealth" /> Similar to the rude real-world slang term "little shit."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/little+shit|text=little shit|quote=''rude slang'' An impudent, trifling person or child.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20221004100630}}</ref>
*'''A load of [[Drutash grub|drutash]] castings''': [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] expression for something that is not true.<ref name="Crucible" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "a load of crap, nonsense, rubbish, etc."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/load-of-crap-nonsense-rubbish-etc|text=a load of crap, nonsense, rubbish, etc.|quote=something that is not true, or something of very bad quality|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230518175504}}</ref>
*'''A load of poodoo''': Referring to something that is not true.<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world rude slang phrase "a load of shit."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/a+load+of+shit|text=a load of shit|quote=''rude slang'' A bunch of nonsense.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230624151051}}</ref>
*'''Loca murishani!''': Crazy [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]!<ref name="Legacy 41" /><ref name="Legacy glossary 2" />
*'''Local Rocket-Fuel''': Slang for any home-brewed [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic beverage]].<ref name="LOE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>
*'''LOL''': Acronym for "laugh out loud," used in [[e-mail]] to express that something is amusing.<ref name="XWA" /> Real-world abbreviation.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/LOL|text=LOL|quote='''abbreviation''' laugh out loud; laughing out loud|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20230507191316}}</ref>
*'''Long [[Limb/Legends|Arm]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]''': [[Artillery/Legends|Artillery]] fire.<ref name="RB" />
*'''Look like something the [[Scurrier/Legends|scurrier]] dragged in''': To look very dirty.<ref name="Sandstorm" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "look like something the cat dragged in."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/look-like-something-the-cat-brought-dragged-in|text=look like something the cat brought/dragged in|quote=to look very untidy and dirty|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230624151836}}</ref>
*'''Loot''': [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] slang for [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]].<ref name="DS" />
*'''Lorda''': [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] for "boss." "Ma lorda" was the Huttese equivalent of "my lord."<ref name="GPBTG" />
*'''[[Lords of Atron]]!''': An exclamation.<ref name="BoG">{{Journal|8|Blaze of Glory (short story)}}</ref> Similar to real-world exclamations like "good lord", "oh lord" etc.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/good-lord|text=good lord oh lord; etc|quote=Lord is used in exclamations such as 'good Lord!' and 'oh Lord!' to express surprise, shock, frustration, or annoyance about something.|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230624152318}}</ref>
*'''Lost in the Wastes''': [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] phrase for being totally unprepared for a given situation. Refers to getting lost in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 7" />
*'''Loz noy jitat''': A curse.<ref name="Legacy glossary 3" />
*'''Lullaby''': [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] slang for [[Suicide pill/Legends|suicide pill]].<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />
*'''Lurdo''': An [[Ewokese/Legends|Ewokese]] term meaning jerk, dummy, etc.<ref name="COC" /><ref name="Warrior Lurdo">{{Ewoks|A Warrior and a Lurdo}}</ref><ref name="Called Me">{{Tales|5|What They Called Me}}</ref>
*'''Lubed''': An exclamation used by [[Ben Skywalker]], meaning cool.<ref name="LOTF:B" />
*'''[[Lum/Legends|Lum]] run''': A task or assignment that has become common or routine, or an endeavor that involves little to no risks.<ref name="Lumrunners">{{Journal|9|Lumrunners}}</ref> Similar to the real-world noun "milk run."<ref name="Milk run" />
*'''Lumrunner''': Term given to [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] who made difficult or even impossible runs look common or routine. It was also a term to describe individuals who gained a reputation for doing easy work or handling low-risk assignments.<ref name="Lumrunners" /> Similar to the real-world noun "milk run."<ref name="Milk run" />
*'''[[Lylek/Legends|Lylek]]-dung-grubber''': An insult used by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Swilja Fenn]], referring to the lylek, a [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] predator.<ref name="Conquest" />

==M==
*'''[[Madclaw]]''': Term for a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who has lashed out against another Wookiee with their claws, which is considered dishonorable and/or a sign of insanity in Wookiee culture.<ref name="KOTOR" />
*'''Make-work''': Work intended to keep a being occupied rather than produce anything of value.<ref name="The Hive">''[[The Hive]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world expression "busy work".
*'''Mandie''': A derogatory term for [[Mandalorian shock trooper]]s, used by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] troops.<ref name="CSWE" />
*'''Manding''': A juvenile slang term with the implied meaning of very or totally, used in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] of the galaxy.<ref name="GNN6" />
*'''Man-of-the-galaxy''': A being with a wide range of experience.<ref name="SOTEn"/> Similar to the real-world expression "man of the world".
*'''[[May the Force be with you/Legends|May the Force be with you]]''': Used to wish an individual good luck<ref name="ANH" /> or good will.<ref name="ROTS" />
*'''May your tribe find joy''': [[Eickarie]] version of greetings with reply '''may your tribe find wealth'''.<ref name="Fool's Bargain">''[[Fool's Bargain]]''</ref>
*'''May warrior's fortune smile on our efforts''': A phrase used by [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Mitth'ras'safis]] before his death aboard ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' and [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] during his campaign prior to the [[Battle for Outbound Flight|Battle of Outbound Flight]].<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>
*'''Max-mag''' or '''maxmag''': Maximum magnification,<ref name="MBS" /> like in "maxmag that," which means "magnify that."<ref name="Star by Star" />
*'''[[Meatbag/Legends|Meatbag]]''': A derogatory term coined by [[HK-47]] to describe any organic being; HK-47 first used this term in reference to [[Darth Malak|Malak]].<ref name="KOTOR" /><ref name="KOTOR2" />
*'''Meat can''': Slang for [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], referring to [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="RC:TZ" /> The term was also used to reference [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]].<ref name="CSWE" />
*'''Meat droid''': A derogatory term for [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="CSWE" />
*'''Mechanical(s)''': Slang for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and other self-operating machinery.<ref name="GTSWU1" />
*'''Medilab''': A medical laboratory. Alternately, '''medlab'''.<ref name="KOTOR2" />
*'''Meet one's destiny''': A euphemism for [[Death/Legends|death]], in particular during a duel or other conflict. Can be used directly towards the opponent (using the second person possessive for the subject of the phrase)<ref name="ROTJ" /> or in reference to someone having been killed in a duel.<ref name="Barely Tolerable 2">{{SW|url=news/barely-tolerable-alien-henchmen-of-the-empire-part-2|text=Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire, Part 2|int=Barely Tolerable: Alien Henchmen of the Empire|date=2013-08-22|quote=The last that was heard of Hoar, he had resumed his hunt for both his old chieftain A'Sharad Hett and the raven-masked Darth Vader, taking his quest as far as the ravaged Outer Rim planet Shumari &mdash; a place much like his old haunt on Tython, littered with the bones, graves and even ghosts of Jedi.
