There, Hoar felt certain he would at last find Hett, slay the Demon Outlander&hellip;or meet his destiny.|nolive=1}}</ref>
*'''Mesh'la''': Beautiful.<ref name="Legacy glossary 3" />
*'''A microcircuit in a stack of electronic scraps''': Something that is considered extremely hard to find, mainly due to the size of the area you'd need to search.<ref name="GG3" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "a needle in a haystack".<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/needle-in-a-haystack|text=a needle in a haystack|quote=something that is impossible or extremely difficult to find, especially because the area you have to search is too large|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20251126193736}}</ref>
*'''Milking''': A mild expletive.<ref name="DS" />
*'''Milking [[mopak]]''': Exclamation.<ref name="DS" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "holy shit"; see '''mopak'''.
*'''Mineral grubber''': An underground miner.<ref name="SME" />
*'''[[Minions of Xendor]]!''': An exclamation.<ref name="tps">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref> This also refers to the followers of the [[darksider]] [[Xendor]] during the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] conflict known as the [[First Great Schism]].<ref name="Heritage of the Sith">{{InsiderCite|88|Heritage of the Sith}}</ref>
*'''Moactan teel''': A rare [[Cheunh/Legends|Cheunh]] expletive, roughly translated to "fair-[[Hair/Legends|haired]]," implying that something about the person was non-[[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]].<ref name="FH1" />
*'''Moisture boy''': Young [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] who come to Mos Eisley headstrong and lacking common sense. Refers to anyone who doesn't know their way around. Highly offensive in [[Moisture farm/Legends|farming]] communities.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 7" />
*'''[[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Cals]] in a [[Fish/Legends|fish]] bowl''': [[Deal-slang]] for many easy big deals from less than intelligent clients.<ref name="Gambler's Life" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "like shooting fish in a barrell," meaning "extremely easy."<ref name="Fish barrel">{{WebCite|url=https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/american_english/barrel_1|text=barrel|quote='''be like shooting fish in a barrel''' ''(informal)'' used to emphasize how easy it is to do something|work=[[Wikipedia:Oxford Learner's Dictionary|''Oxford Learner's Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230422221917}}</ref>
*'''[[Monkey-lizard]] chase''': A futile search.<ref name="Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world phrase wild goose chase.<ref name="Goosey" />
*'''Moojpuck''': An [[Ansionian]] expletive, often used by the [[Gwurran]].<ref name="TAS" />
*'''Mopak''': An expletive. It could refer to nonsense, e.g. "pure mopak";<ref name="DS" /> trouble, e.g. "'''in deep mopak'''";<ref name="TAS" /> a bad situation, e.g. "all the mopak [[Jax Pavan|Jax]] had been through";<ref name="Jedi Twilight">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> or something of bad quality, e.g. "He's a mopak [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]]."<ref name="Leebo">{{InsiderCite|128|And Leebo Makes Three}}</ref> It could also be used as an insult, such as "the stupid mopak";<ref name="DS" /> or as an exclamation, e.g. "'''milking mopak'''."<ref name="DS" /> The phrase "'''scare the mopak out of'''" meant to terrify someone.<ref name="The Last Jedi" /> The use of the word is similar to the real-world swear word "shit."
*'''Moron''': A stupid or foolish individual.<ref name="AFM">{{CWACite|4|Another Fine Mess}}</ref>
*'''Mos''': Element of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] cities (e.g. [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]).<ref name="Worlds Episode I">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref>
*'''[[Mosquito/Legends|Mosquitos]]''': Used by [[Treve]] to refer to a group of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[remote droid]]s.<ref name="Stealth" />
*'''[[Parent/Legends|Mother]]''': [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] slang for [[Case officer/Legends|case officer]].<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />
*'''Mother of [[Kurkuoth|Kwath]]!''': An exclamation.<ref name="PoNR">{{TCW|Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)}}</ref> Similar to the real-world interjection "mother of God."<ref name="Holy mother" />
*'''Mradhe Muck''': A curse, as in "What the blinkin' mradhe muck is going on here?"<ref name="Specter of the Past" />
*'''MRR''': An abbreviation of "Meals ready to regurgitate," the name given by Rebel Alliance fighter pilots to food provided by Imperial forces after capture<ref name="MRR">{{CSWECite|II|339|MRR}}</ref>
*'''[[Much Regret Unable|MRU]]''': Much regret, unable.<ref name="RC:TZ" />
*'''[[Mudcrutch]]''': An insult.<ref name="Republic 57">[[Republic 57|''Republic'' 57]]</ref> Also '''mudcrutch whelp'''.<ref name="Path of Destruction" />
*'''Mudfoot''': Armor crew term for infantry attached to walker units.<ref name="RB" />
*'''Mudlicker''': An insult meaning unskilled or incompetent.<ref name="KOTOR2" />
*'''Mulligrubs''': An expression of unease, as in "gave her the mulligrubs."<ref name="TFAD">{{Journal|6|To Fight Another Day}}</ref> Similar to the real-world phrase "give someone the creeps."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/give-the-creeps|text=give someone the creeps|quote=to cause someone to have uncomfortable feelings of nervousness or fear|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230623071523}}</ref>
*'''Munk''': A [[Stassian]] expletive, indicating a form of excrement.<ref name="Ringers" />
*'''[[Murglak/Legends|Murglak]]''': An insult;<ref name="Star Wars 20">[[Star Wars (1998) 20|''Star Wars'' (1998) 20]]</ref> derogatory [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] term.<ref name="Legacy glossary 3" /> See also '''son of a Murglak'''.
*'''[[Mynock/Legends|Mynock]]''': (v) To scavenge or steal from another, to profit from another's accomplishment or loot from another's kill (e.g., "someone comes along and mynocks your kill").<ref name="KOTOR2" /> Also a non-[[canon]] insult, e.g. "crazy old mynock."<ref name="Ghost" />
*'''Mynock [[Muffin/Legends|muffins]]!''': An expletive similar to '''[[Bantha fodder/Legends|bantha fodder]]'''.<ref name="LCSTB" />
*'''Mynock with his tail on fire''': Slang for an irresistible attraction.<ref name="Specter of the Past" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "moth to a light".
*'''Myra's tentacles''': An exclamation.<ref name="Stock" />
*'''My [[Star/Legends|stars]]''': Exclamation of shock<ref name="Legacy War 2">[[Legacy — War 2|''Legacy — War'' 2]]</ref> or surprise.<ref name="Tyrant" /> A real-world exclamation that is now regarded as archaic.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.oed.com/dictionary/star_n1?tl=true#1183963070|text=star|quote='''P.4.''' In ''plural''. In exclamations expressing surprise, exasperation, excitement, etc. '''P.4.a. my stars!''' and variants. Now '''archaic'''.|work=[[Wikipedia:Oxford English Dictionary|''Oxford English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20250704234100}}</ref> Also similar to another, real-world exclamation, "oh my God!"<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/(oh)+(my)+God!|text=(oh) (my) God!|quote=An exclamation of surprise, alarm, dismay, annoyance, or exasperation.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20250705002821}}</ref>

==N==
*'''Nebbie''': A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] term for the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
*'''Needle match''': A phrase used by [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] leaders to refer to a personal disagreement between men<ref name="NeedleMatch">{{CSWECite|II|367|needle match}}</ref>
*'''Neep''': A slang term for a person that installs computer systems.<ref name="CSWE" />
*'''Neg that''': Expression used by [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Tahiri Veila]] to mean "that's negative" or "false."<ref name="Star by Star" />
*'''Negatron''': A negative interjection essentially meaning "no."<ref name="HSLL" />
*'''Neimie''': [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]-era slang for [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]].<ref name="CSWE" />
*'''[[Nerf/Legends|Nerf]] and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] Show''': An overstaged presentation.<ref name="Traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world "dog and pony show."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/dog-and-pony-show|text=dog and pony show|quote=an event that is designed to impress people in order to make them buy something or invest money|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230307060715}}</ref>
*'''Nerf-[[Brain/Legends|brain]]''': An insult, referring to a stupid person.<ref name="Renegade">''[[Rebel Force: Renegade]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world insult "birdbrain."<ref name="Birdbrain" />
*'''Nerf dung''': An insult.<ref name="Eaten Alive">''[[Galaxy of Fear: Eaten Alive]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world noun "piece of shit."<ref name="Piece of shit">{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/piece+of+shit|text=piece of shit|quote=1. ''rude slang'' A derisive term for something that one considers utterly worthless or inferior. (...) 2. ''rude slang'' A derisive term for someone whom one considers contemptible or deplorable.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20250711002749}}</ref>
*'''[[Nerf herder/Legends|Nerf herder]]''': Individuals who herded members of the nerf [[Species/Legends|species]]; used as an insult.<ref name="ESB" /><ref name="SWL2" /> The corresponding adjective for the insult "nerf herder" was "'''nerf-herding'''"; when [[Salla Zend]] was reunited with her former lover [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], she referred to him as a "nerf-herdin' son of a —."<ref name="Dark Empire 3">[[Dark Empire 3|''Dark Empire'' 3]]</ref>
*'''Nerf-rider''': An insult.<ref name="Dark Empire II 1">[[Dark Empire II 1|''Dark Empire II'' 1]]</ref>
*'''[[Nek/Legends|Nek]] take it''': A curse used on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="SW 1998 20">[[Star Wars (1998) 20|''Star Wars'' (1998) 20]]</ref>
*'''Nekouda''': A [[Ysannan/Legends|Ysannan]] curse.<ref name="Empire's End 1" />
*'''Nerve Burner''': An insult referring to mental stability.<ref name="ESB" />
*'''[[Nessie]]''': Slang for a native of the [[Stenness Node]].<ref name="TOTJ 3">[[Tales of the Jedi 3|''Tales of the Jedi'' 3]]</ref>
*'''Nest-fellow''': A Basic term for anyone from the same hive or colony.<ref name="CSWE" />
*'''Never let me see his traitorous [[Mouth/Legends|beak]] again''': Spoken by the [[Targonnian]] [[Craw]] while firing a [[Craw's chief advisor|fellow Targonnian]];<ref name="Droids 6" /> similar to the way a non-[[Bird/Legends|avian]] might say "never let me see his traitorous face again."
*'''Newsblink''': A small piece of news that was delivered quickly<ref name="Newsblink">{{CSWECite|II|376|newsblink}}</ref>
*'''NFQ''': Normal For [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]]. Slang used by clone commandos during a mission on Qiilura.<ref name="RC:HC" />
*'''Nicely dressed''': Gambler slang for any being very obviously carrying weapons, such as bounty hunters. The opposite of '''stylishly dressed.'''<ref name="CSWE" />
*'''Nightcrawler''': Term used by inhabitants of Tatooine for small insects active during the night.<ref name="GTSWU1" />
*'''[[No-being's-land]]''': An area separating two or more opposing ground forces, but unclaimed by none. Often reduced to a wasteland, and virtually always dangerous.<ref name="JT" /> Similar to the real-world noun "no-man's land."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/no-man-s-land?q=no-man%27s-land|text=no-man's-land|quote=an area or strip of land that no one owns or controls, such as a strip of land between two countries' borders, especially in a war|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230621213332}}</ref>
*'''No [[Poodoo/Legends|poodoo]]''': Used as an expression of surprise.<ref name="DS" /> Similar to the real-world offensive idiom "no shit."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/no-shit|text=no shit!|quote=an expression of surprise, often used as a joke when someone has told you something that is very obvious|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230621213531}}</ref>
*'''Noob''': A new addition to a military unit; often pejorative. Can also refer to a veteran making a rookie mistake. The corresponding adjective was '''noobish'''.<ref name="Legacy 4" /><ref name="Vortex" /><ref name="Legacy 14">[[Legacy (2006) 14|''Legacy'' (2006) 14]]</ref>"Noob" is a real-world noun for an inexperienced person.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/noob|text=noob|quote=someone who has just started doing something, especially playing a computer game or using a type of software, and so does not know much about it|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230621213806}}</ref>
*'''Noodlefishing''': A term [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] used to describe the mindless activities of most politicians' lives.<ref name="CSWE" />
*'''Not firing on all thrusters''': Not entirely sane.<ref name="Traitor" />
*'''Not give a bucket of [[tusker]] poop''': A [[Korun/Legends|Korun]] phrase, meaning not to care about something at all.<ref name="SP" /> Similar to the real-world offensive idiom "not give a shit."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/not-give-a-shit|text=not give a shit|quote=to not be interested in or worried about something or someone|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230621214016}}</ref>
*'''Not the brightest [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in sheath''': Unintelligent,<ref name="Outgunned">{{Tales|7|Outbid But Never Outgunned}}</ref> similar to the real world idiom "not the sharpest knife in the drawer."<ref name="Look sharp">{{WebCite|url=https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/american_english/sharp_1|text=sharp|quote=Idioms '''not the sharpest knife in the drawer, not the sharpest tool in the shed''' ''(informal) (humorous)'' not intelligent|work=[[Wikipedia:Oxford Learner's Dictionary|''Oxford Learner's Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230418194825}}</ref>
*'''Not [their] cup of elba''': Something a person doesn't particularly like.<ref name="VOTF" /> Similar to the real-world phrase, "not [their] cup of tea".<ref name="Cup of tea">{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/not-be-cup-of-tea|text=not be someone's cup of tea|quote=If something is not your cup of tea, it is not the type of thing that you like|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20250424031532}}</ref>
*'''Nova-happy''': An insult used by [[Jolli]] to describe [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in response to his insulting her; exact meaning uncertain; compare '''[[Realspace/Legends|space]]-happy'''.<ref name="SW7" />
*'''Noxious''': An [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] term for [[Imperial Security]]<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" /> and [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] personnel.<ref name="CSWE" />
*'''NRU''': Nice Red Uniform. [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|SpecOps]] slang for [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Imperial Royal Guardsmen]].<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Nut''': Slang noun for a crazy person.<ref name="Underworld">{{InsiderCite|89|Underworld: A Galaxy of Scum and Villainy}}</ref> Real-world noun.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/nut|text=nut|quote=a person who behaves in a very silly, stupid, or strange way|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230621214230}}</ref>
*'''Nuts''': Slang adjective for crazy.<ref name="SW8" /><ref name="KOTOR" /> Real-world word.

==O==
*'''Off your [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]]''': Crazy.<ref name="SWV" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "off your rocker."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/off-rocker|text=off your rocker|quote=If you say that someone is off their rocker, you mean that that person is behaving in a very strange or silly way.|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230617195016}}</ref>
*'''Oh crap''': Expression of dismay, usually used in anger or frustration.<ref name="SWV">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref> Offensive real-world interjection.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/crap|text=crap|quote=10. ''interjection, rude slang'' Used to express sudden panic, anger, irritation, or exasperation. '''A: "I think the boss found out about the missing money." B: "Crap. What am I going to do?" Oh, crap—the motor has burnt out on this mower again!''|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230617194524}}</ref>
*'''Oh [[God/Legends|gods]]!''': Exclamation of relief.<ref name="Rebel Heist 3">[[Rebel Heist 3|''Rebel Heist'' 3]]</ref> Extension of the real-world exclamation "oh god."
*'''Oh mooie-mooie''': [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] exclamation.<ref name="TPM" /> Phonetically similar to the real-world idiom "my oh my."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/my-oh-my|text=my, (oh, my)|quote=used to express surprise or pleasure|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230617192840}}</ref>
*'''Oh my''': Exclamation of surprise or incredulity<ref name="TPM" /> from the real world.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/oh+my|text=oh my|quote=An expression of concern, surprise, or incredulity.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230513082102}}</ref>
*'''Oh my goodness''': Exclamation of surprise<ref name="AOTC" /> from the real world.
*'''Oh my skies''': Exclamation,<ref name="RFC">{{Journal|7|Retreat from Coruscant}}</ref> similar to the real-world phase "oh my God/goodness."
*'''Oh, my [[Star/Legends|stars]]''': An exclamation.<ref name="SOL" /><ref name="SW 99">[[Star Wars (1977) 99|''Star Wars'' (1977) 99]]</ref><ref name="Empire 17"> [[Empire 17|''Empire'' 17]]</ref> Real-world [[Wikipedia:American English|American English]] interjection.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.reverso.net/english-definition/oh+my+stars|text=oh my stars|quote=US (…) '''1.''' ''(emotion)'' expression of surprise or amazement (…) '''2.''' ''(expression)'' expression of frustration or annoyance|work=[[Wikipedia:Reverso (language tools)|''Reverso English Dictionary'']]|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/5X7RD}}</ref>
*'''Old Order''': A term used to describe the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as far back as the [[Mandalorian Wars]], when it was used by [[Cassus Fett]].<ref name="The Taris Holofeed Special Proclamation">{{KOTORbackups|21}}</ref> It was also used to refer to the original [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] after the establishment of the [[New Jedi Order]].<ref name="DT1" />
*'''Old Spaceman's Home''': Retirement; to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]].<ref name="HSSE" />
*'''Old Spacer's Home''': Retirement for spacers.<ref name="TFO">{{Journal|15|Two for One}}</ref>
*'''Old timer''': A term used by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to describe or address old men such as [[Don-Wan Kihotay]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="SW11" /> Real-world noun.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/old-timer|text=old-timer|quote=an old man, or someone who has been or worked in a place for a long time|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230617192038}}</ref>
*'''OmegaAxl''': Expression of awesomeness.<ref name="DL" />
*'''One-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] [[Egg/Legends|egg]]-sucking sons of slime-devils''': An insult.<ref name="The Last One Standing: TTOBF">{{StoryCite|story=The Last One Standing: The Tale of Boba Fett|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref> "Egg-sucking" is similar to the real-world noun "suck-egg," referring to someone who is young, stupid, or despicable.<ref name="Suck-egg" /> "Sons of slime-devils" is similar to the real-world idiom "sons of bitches," the plural form of "son of a bitch."<ref name="Son of a">{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/son-of-a-bitch|text=son of a bitch|quote='''Word forms:''' ''plural'' '''sons of bitches''' • ''vulgar slang'' • '''1.''' a contemptible or thoroughly disagreeable person; scoundrel '''2.''' a disagreeable matter; a chore '''3.''' (used as an exclamation of impatience, irritation, astonishment, etc.) • Also: son-of-a-bitch|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archiveurl=https://archive.is/ZuHS2}}</ref>
*'''One [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]] does not an infestation make''': Proverb used by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]; one instance of an event does not necessarily indicate a trend.<ref name="Wild Space" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "one swallow does not make a summer."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/one+swallow+does+not+make+a+summer|text=one swallow does not make a summer|quote=One piece of evidence does not mean that something is definitely the case or is going to happen. A reference to the migration of swallows that happens in the spring or early summer.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230619163453}}</ref>
*'''Only [[Human/Legends|human]]''': Meaning that humans can't be expected to be perfect, and it is normal for them to do wrong things.<ref name="XKT" /> Real-world phrase.<ref>{{LinkedIn|url=pulse/meaning-im-only-human-dr-bridget-kirsop|text=The meaning of "I'm only human!"|author=Dr Bridget Kirsop|date=2021-05-10|quote=It's the sort of thing we say when we feel we are not perfect and we are justifying some sort of behaviour.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/Isdi7}}</ref>
*'''On someone's [[Afterburner/Legends|afterburners]]''': Following someone closely.<ref name="S:C2" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "(hot) on someone's heels."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/hot-on-heels|text=(hot) on someone's heels|quote=following closely behind someone|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230521173944}}</ref>
*'''One [[Stang/Legends|Stang]] of a [[Time/Legends|time]]''': Used to describe something difficult, e.g., "We'll have one Stang of a time getting them to surface again."<ref name="SME" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "one hell of a time."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/one+hell+of+a+time|text=hell of a time|quote= Describing something (often a task or chore) that is, was, or will be very difficult or unpleasant.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230617190251}}</ref>
*'''Ootman''': Huttese for "outlander."<ref name="Kenobi">[[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']]</ref>
*'''Open [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]], insert [[Boot/Legends|boot]]''': Meaning someone has said something inappropriate.<ref name="SW8" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "put your foot in your mouth."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/put-foot-in-mouth|text=to say or do something that you should not have, esp. something that embarrasses someone else|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230329225403}}</ref>
*'''[[Ord]]''': Acronym for [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]]. Often an element in place names, for instance [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]], or [[Ord Pardron/Legends|Ord Pardron]].
*'''Organics''': A derogatory term coined by [[HK-50 series assassin droid|HK-50s]] to describe any organic being. This term made [[HK-47]] very upset, prompting him to say, ''"'Anger' would be an understatement for the heat that builds up in my behavior core when these cheap imitations make their presence felt throughout the galaxy."''<ref name="KOTOR2" />
*'''Orphan''': [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] slang for disbanding an intelligence network, thereby "orphaning" the agents in the field.<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />
*'''Osik''': Mandalorian expletive, referring to excrement.<ref name="RC:TZ" /><ref name="Odds">{{InsiderCite|87|Odds}}</ref> Similar to the real-world swear word "shit."
*'''[[Ossus Day]]''': A day of reflection, coined by Jedi but also observed in many parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
*'''Ou''': Apparently, the [[Alwari]] term for "oh."<ref name="TAS" />
*'''Outboard''': A term used to describe the outer hull of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], something mounted on the hull of a ship, or something outside the ship entirely.<ref name="GTSWU1" />
*'''Out of the woods''': A phrase meaning "escaped from danger" used by Han Solo.<ref name="SW5" /> Real-world idiom.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/out-of-the-woods|text=out of the woods|quote=not having a problem or difficulty any longer|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20220503090216}}</ref>
*'''[[Outlander]]''': A term used to describe or address someone from a different [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="AOTC" /> Real-world noun for someone who hails from another country or area.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/outlander|text=outlander|quote=a person who is not from your country or area|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230617191038}}</ref>
*'''Out of deep [[Ronto/Legends|ronto]] [[Poodoo/Legends|poodoo]]''': To stay out of trouble.<ref name="Patterns" />
*'''Out of your [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorian]] mind''': Non-[[canon]] phrase meaning crazy, inzane; spoken to a [[Mace Windu/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="Force Fiction">{{Tales|7|Force Fiction}}</ref> Extension of the real-world idiom "out of your mind."
*'''Outworlder''': Another term used to describe or address someone from a different planet.<ref name="SW7" />

==P==
*'''Pacify''': [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] slang for to [[Death/Legends|kill]].<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />
*'''P for Plenty''': A phrase used by [[Kal Skirata|Kal Skirata's]] trained group of [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null ARCs]] to describe the amount of explosives needed in any given situation.<ref name="RC:HC" />
*'''Pagh''': A dismissive or derisive [[Ansionian (language)|Ansionian]] term.<ref name="TAS" />
*'''Pain in the [[Choobies/Legends|choobies]]''': An expression used for something that caused discomfort or was otherwise troublesome.<ref name="Dark Forces 4">{{WizardsCite|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050526a|text=The Dark Forces Saga, Part 4|int=The Dark Forces Saga}}</ref> Similar to the real-world offensive idiom "pain in the ass/butt."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/pain-in-the-ass-butt|text=a pain in the ass/butt|quote=''idiom'' US offensive (UK '''pain in the arse/backside''') someone or something that is very annoying|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230216013148}}</ref>
*'''[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] advocate''': Challenging the popular opinion by voicing an opposing view in order to encourage discussion and thought on the topic.<ref name="rev" /> Similar to the real-world noun "devil's advocate."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/devil-s-advocate|text=devil's advocate|quote=someone who pretends, in an argument or discussion, to be against an idea or plan that a lot of people support, in order to make people discuss and consider it in more detail|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20221118001512}}</ref>
*'''Palpatine's got a [[Darth Sidious' lightsabers|lightsaber]]''': An expression used when a person doubted someone else.<ref name="DS" /> A reference to Palpatine's deception.
*'''Palps''': A term commonly used for Chancellor/Emperor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] by [[Omega Squad|Omega]] and [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta]] squads.<ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>
*'''Parking slip''': A defined space to park surface vehicles.<ref name="GTSWU1" />
*'''[[Pateesa (phrase)/Legends|Pateesa]]''': Friend, sweetie, darling.<ref name="Legacy glossary 3" />
*'''Pazaak shark''': A term used for a very good [[Pazaak/Legends|pazaak]] player; usually indicating that the player in question is posing as a novice in order to sucker large amounts of money from their victims.<ref name="KOTOR2" />
*'''Peachy''': Great.<ref name="SW8" /> Real-world adjective.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/peachy|text=peachy|quote=very good|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230603190906}}</ref>
*'''Peedunky''': A Huttese insult, translating loosely as punk.<ref name="TPM" />
*'''Peel open like a can of [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] gizzards''': To forcefully peel open; often used by starfighter pilots in reference to an enemy ship.<ref name="TotJA">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>
*'''Peewo''': Pronunciation of the acronym for "principal weapons officer"; in use aboard Republic naval ships during the Clone Wars.<ref name="RC:TZ" />
*'''Penniless''': An adjective used by [[Crimson Jack/Legends|Crimson Jack]] to describe [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] after robbing him of treasure, meaning "without money."<ref name="SW11" /> Real-world adjective.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/penniless|text=penniless|quote=having no money|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230603191112}}</ref>
*'''Permes''': Term for a person from the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]], that was thereby eligble for marriage to a member of the [[Ensterite]], a [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] sect which forbade [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] with anyone from outside the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="MBS" />
*'''Phwoar''': A [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] expletive.<ref name="RC:HC" />
*'''Picking between One and Fourteen''': Slang for a choice between equally bad outcomes. Originates from miners in the [[Lythos system/Legends|Lythos system]] which had to choose whether to work on fiery [[Lythos I]] or frigid [[Lythos XIV]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*'''A piece of [[Cake/Legends|cake]]''' or merely '''piece of cake''': Very easy.<ref name="SOTEn">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> Real-world idiom.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/piece-of-cake|text=a piece of cake|quote=something that is very easy to do|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230508181725}}</ref>
*'''Piece of [[Poodoo/Legends|poodoo]]''': Something utterly worthless.<ref name="Stealth" /> Similar to the real-world slang phrase "piece of shit."<ref name="Piece of shit" />
*'''Piffer''': Slang for an attractive woman.<ref name="Mara Jade 4" />
*'''Pifgah''': A [[Gwurran]] expletive, used when one was frustrated.<ref name="TAS" />
*'''Pifgot''': A Gwurran expletive, used when one was frustrated.<ref name="TAS" />
*'''Piglet-Mommy''': A derogatory statement used by [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]].<ref name="COTJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>
*'''Pile of poodoo''': A bunch of lies.<ref name="Star Wars 40">[[Star Wars (1998) 40|''Star Wars'' (1998) 40]]</ref> Similar to the real-world idiom "pile of shit."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/pile+of+shit|text=pile of shit|quote=1. ''vulgar slang'' A lot of malicious or ignorant lies.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20211020110333}}</ref>
*'''Pinkie''' or '''pinky''': Slang term used by [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] such as [[Kerlo]]<ref name="Incident at Horn Station">{{Tales|2|Incident at Horn Station}}</ref> and [[Warto]] to address humans.<ref name="SW8" />
*'''Piston-head''': Derogatory term used to describe the [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droid]] series, as [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] referred to them.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid">{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid}}</ref>
*'''Plan B''': A term used by [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]],<ref name="tps" /> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]],<ref name="ROTS" /> Mandalorians&mdash;Mandalorians always had a plan B "just in case"&mdash;<ref name="apm">''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]''</ref> and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Caedus]].<ref name="rev">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref> It referred to a backup plan; when used in the context of a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] or [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], it could refer to additional soldiers ready to support a soldier even if that soldier felt he or she would not need help.<ref name="apm" /> Some beings, such as [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], sometimes didn't prepare any "plan B," sticking with just the primary "plan A" (B being the second letter in the [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]] and A the first).<ref name="tps" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] asked [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], "Do you have a plan B?" when they were trapped in ray shields aboard The Invisible Hand.<ref name="ROTS" /> Real-world noun.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/plan-b|text=Plan B|quote=a plan or method that you use if another one fails, or is likely to fail|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20220503215259}}</ref>
*'''Planetfall''': A term to describe the act of landing on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="HSSE" /><ref name="HSLL" /><ref name="HSRevenge" /> Adapted from the real-world noun "landfall."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/landfall|text=landfall|quote=the first land that is reached or seen at the end of a journey across the sea or through the air, or the fact of arriving there|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230510192232}}</ref>
*'''Plastic boy''': Rebel slang for stormtrooper or any Imperial in armor.<ref name="SWBF2" />
*'''Plastic soldier''': SpecOps term for a stormtrooper.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Pleasure Planet in the Purple Systems''': A phrase used to describe a euphoric place<ref name="MiS">{{JournalCite|14|Murder in Slushtime}}</ref>
*'''[[Poison/Legends|Poison]]''': Alliance Intelligence slang for [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]].<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />
*'''Pointer''': Slang term commonly used by [[Invids|Invid]] pilots, in reference to the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="IJ" />
*'''[[Poodoo/Legends|Podoo]]''': A [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] term meaning "fodder," a coarse type of food for livestock.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Used as a swear word,<ref name="TPM" /> and also as a term for nonsense,<ref name="MF" /> or someone<ref name="Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref> or something that a person disliked.<ref name="Tempest" /> The word and its various meanings are similar to the real-world impolite word "shit."
*'''Popper''': [[Gallisport]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] slang. A [[riot suppression gun]]. So-called because of the distinctive popping sound the weapon made.<ref name="SG" />
*'''Pound Ground''': To disembark from a vehicle.<ref name="HSSE" />
*'''[[Poundies|Poundie]]''': A term used by [[Miner/Legends|miners]] of the [[Mestra system/Legends|Mestra system]] when referring to a [[Smelting ship|smelting ship]]'s crewmember.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>
*'''Predsill''': A insult.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
*'''Preflight rundown''': The series of instrumentation and mechanical checks made aboard a starship prior to takeoff.<ref name="GTSWU1" />
*'''Pretzel-bender''': A colloquial term for someone who makes pretzels.<ref name="LCFO" />
*'''Prime''': Juvenile equivalent to "cool." Similar to "wizard."<ref name="GOF" />
*'''Proties''': [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] slang for someone or something that is perceived as useless. Short for [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]].<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''Prugnuficating''': An as yet unknown disgusting act or natural phenomenon;<ref name="Nampi" /> possibly some variation of defecating, putrefying, or both.<ref name="Cuss" />
*'''PSC''': Plastic Soldier Carrier. SpecOps term for an Imperial AT-AT walker.<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Puck''': Walker crew term for repulsortanks.<ref name="RB" />
*'''Puck-Heads''': Walker crew term for repulsortank crews.<ref name="RB" />
*'''Pulling a Bindo''': A term used to describe a Jedi who had disobeyed the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]] by marrying. The term originated from the exploits of the rogue [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Jolee Bindo]].<ref name="KOTOR2" />
*'''Punching up a jump''': The act of entering coordinates into a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] prior to making the jump to lightspeed.<ref name="GTSWU1" />
*'''Pure [[Pazaak/Legends|pazaak]]''' or '''[[Pure Sabacc/Legends|pure sabacc]]''': A slang term indicating perfect, derived from a winning pazaak/[[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] hand.<ref name="KOTOR2" /> Similar to the real-world exclamation "bingo."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/bingo|text=bingo|quote=an expression of surprise and, usually, pleasure, for example when something happens successfully|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230313212805}}</ref>
*'''[[Pustina]]''': A [[Drach'nam]] expletive.<ref name="Jade Solitaire">{{StoryCite|story=Jade Solitaire|book=Tales from the New Republic}}</ref>
*'''Put on your retro-rockets''': Used to tell someone to wait, slow down.<ref name="SW8" />
*'''Puul''': A [[Yuuzhan Vong]] expletive.<ref name="EOV:C">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref>

==R==
*'''Race the run''': [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] slang for going for one end of the [[Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route]] to the other.<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''Race the run adrift''': Elrood sector slang for going for one end of the Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route to the other, and making it to [[Derilyn]].<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''Raim''': A curse word.<ref name="DF">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref>
*'''Raising ship''': Leaving a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] or the act of lifting off.<ref name="GTSWU1" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "raise sail", meaning to begin a journey, especially on water.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.wordhippo.com/what-is/another-word-for/raise_sail.html|text=What is another word for raise sail|quote=To begin a voyage, especially on water|work=WordHippo|archivedate=20230526153913}}</ref>
*'''Rake''': Slang term for a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]].<ref name="SOTEn" />
*'''[[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]]-roll''': To overwhelm, crush.<ref name="VOTF" /> Similar to the real-world verb "steamroll."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/american_english/steamroll|text=steamroll|quote=to defeat someone or force them to do something, using your power or authority|work=[[Wikipedia:Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary|''Oxford Learner's Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20250122123710}}</ref>
*'''[[Rankweed/Legends|Rankweed]] sucker''': An insult.<ref name="MBS" /><ref name="DM:SH">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world noun "suck-egg," referring to someone who is young, stupid, or despicable.<ref name="Suck-egg" />
*'''Ratch''': An insult.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" />
*'''[[Ratitan whisperfly]]''': Slang for a rule or order that one stubbornly sticks by. Named as such after an insect known for its low, insistent buzzing.<ref name="Specter of the Past" />
*'''RawMat''' or '''rawmat''': Corporate slang for "raw materials."<ref name="GNN 7">{{Journal|7|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref><ref name="GNN 8">{{Journal|8|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref><ref name="Hnn-Baktoid Closes Down Five More Plants">{{Hnn|46|business/1337_1.html|Baktoid Closes Down Five More Plants}}</ref>
*'''Raygun''': A term used by inhabitants of backwater planets to describe [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] technology.<ref name="TRG-Native">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]&mdash;Tough Native template</ref>
*'''RC''': Acronym for "[[Clone commando/Legends|Republic commando]]."<ref name="RC:HC" />
*'''RPC''': Acronym for "Request the Pleasure of your Company."<ref name="RC:TZ" />
*'''Reading the g's''': Term used by fighter pilots in reference to dialing down an [[Acceleration compensator/Legends|inertial compensator]] to get a tactile feel for the movements of their ships.<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>
*'''Readout''': Term for data produced by a data bank or electronic measuring instrument; a video monitor linked to a data storage and retrieval system.<ref name="GTSWU1" />
*'''Rear echelon [[Bantha fodder/Legends|bantha fodder]]''': Slang term for support personnel, usually not fit for combat or heavy duty, in the military.<ref name="Fury" />
*'''Rebel scum''': Disdainful term for a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], used almost exclusively by Imperials.<ref name="ROTJ" /><ref name="SWBF2" />
*'''"Rebel scum this!"''': Rebel trooper response to the above insult.<ref name="SWBF2" />
*'''REBJ''': Acronym for "Rapid Entry By Jedi," used by [[Galactic Alliance Guard]].<ref name="LOTF:B" />
*'''Redrobes''': Slang for the [[Red Guard]]s who protected the Supreme Chancellor and later the Emperor.<ref name="ROTSn" />
*'''Red Zero''': Military term for requesting immediate extraction.<ref name="RC:TZ" />
*'''Recce''': Short for "reconnaissance."<ref name="RC:TZ" /> Real-world [[Wikipedia:British English|British English]] noun.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/recce|text=recce|quote=''noun'' [ C ] <small>UK informal</small> the process of getting information about enemy forces or positions by sending out small groups of soldiers or by using aircraft, etc.|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230526153636}}</ref>
*'''Rep''': Associate of the Republic; used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Republic 74">[[Republic 74|''Republic'' 74]]</ref> Also used about associates of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>
*'''[[Replonza]]''': An expletive used by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] when she crashed on the planet [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]].<ref name="SME" />
*'''Ridge-head parachute''': "Ridge-head" is slang for [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], but the meaning of "parachute" here is unknown.<ref name="VP" />
*'''Riding the mirrors''': A term given to piloting the orbital climate control mirrors on Coruscant.<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>
*'''Rimkin''': Slur referring to the inhabitants of the systems in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="IAD">{{StoryCite|story=Interlude at Darkknell|book=Tales from the New Republic}}</ref> During the [[Pius Dea Era]], it was used by [[Pius Dea]] [[Pius Dea|Faithful]] to refer to alien converts.<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*'''Rimmer''': Slang for a being hailing from the Outer Rim.<ref name="DF:SFTE" />
*'''Rock''': Slang for "planet." Sometimes used degradingly to refer to barren worlds like [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="ANH" />
*'''Rock chewers''': Elrood sector slang for [[Miner/Legends|miners]].<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''Rocketjock''': Slang for a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="DS" />
*'''Rocket-rabbit''': A slang term [[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]] applies to himself, perhaps meaning a [[Lepi/Legends|Lepi]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]].<ref name="SW10" />
*'''Rocket Riders''': [[Speeder bike/Legends|Speeder bike]]-mounted [[Scout/Legends|scouts]].<ref name="RB" />
*'''[[Rodder]]''': A swear word;<ref name="The Unseen Queen">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref> could also be used as an insult.<ref name="The Swarm War">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref> Similar to the rude real-world [[Wikipedia:British English|British English]] noun/exclamation "bugger."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/bugger|text=bugger|quote=<small>UK offensive</small> a rude word for a silly or annoying person (...) <small>UK offensive</small> a rude word used to express anger|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230705130535}}</ref>
*'''Rodie''': Short for Rodian.<ref name="AHF:GT">{{StoryCite|story=A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>
*'''Roller''': [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] slang for a [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|Hailfire droid]].<ref name="SWBF2" /> Also slang for a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]], used amongst the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]].<ref name="SWRC" />
*'''Rollies''': Clone trooper slang for [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]].<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>
*'''Rolling deathballs''': Another slang for droidekas, as [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] referred to them.<ref name="The Clone Wars film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>
*'''Roods''': Elrood sector slang for anyone born or having spent most of their life in the sector.<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''Rookie''': Slang name given to new recruits of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|GAR]] by older, more battle-worn clones. Same as "[[Shiny/Legends|shinie]]."<ref name="Rookies" /> Real-world noun for someone who has just begun a career and lacks expertise, particularly someone who has just joined the armed forces or police.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/rookie|text=rookie|quote=A rookie is someone who has just started doing a job and does not have much experience, especially someone who has just joined the army or police force.|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230526151850}}</ref>
*'''Rot you''': Expletive<ref name="Boba Fett: Enemy of the Empire 1">[[Boba Fett: Enemy of the Empire 1|''Boba Fett: Enemy of the Empire'' 1]]</ref> similar to the real-world phrase "damn you."
*'''RTs''': [[Gallisport]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] slang. Standing for "Real Things" – actual [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement officials]] who remain safe behind the walled sections of Gallisport.<ref name="SG" />
*'''Rulebook''': Elrood sector slang for [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], referring to people who take the law into their own hands by using it. Also '''law book'''.<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''The Run''': Elrood sector nickname for the Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route.<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''Running like [[Hopskip (creature)|hopskips]]''': Slang for running away, comparing the subject to hopskips; a creature known to run.<ref name="VOTF" />
*'''Rust bucket''': A run-down vehicle.<ref name="The White Witch" /> Real-world [[Wikipedia:British English|British English]] slang.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/rust-bucket|text=rust bucket|quote='''in British English''' NOUN 1. ''slang'' something that is run-down or dilapidated, esp a very badly rusted car|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/1cCTi}}</ref>
*'''RV''': Short for rendezvous, either the noun or the verb. Can also refer to the location of a rendezvous.<ref name="RC:TZ" />

==S==
*'''[[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] face''': An expression to hide one's true emotions.<ref name="Star by Star" /> Similar to the real-world term "poker face."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/poker-face|text=poker face|quote=an expression on someone's face that does not show what they are thinking or feeling|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230429003314}}</ref>
*'''[[Sand Banthas]]''': Term used by [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] personnel in reference to [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends#4th Regiment - SpecForce Wilderness Fighters|Desert Wilderness Fighters]].<ref name="Engagement" />
*'''Sand mine''': [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] slang for something worthless; something that anyone with common sense should know better than to get involved with.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 7" />
*'''Sandman''': [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|SpecOps]] term for a [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|sandtrooper]].<ref name="GG9" />
*'''Saving your choobics''': To rescue someone, e.g. "saving your choobics from someone with a [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]]."<ref name="Luke's Freighter">{{WEGCite|story=Luke's Freighter|book=The Last Command Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref> Similar to the real-world idiom "save someone's ass."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/save%20one%27s%2Fsomeone%27s%20ass|text=save one's/someone's ass|quote=to help oneself/someone else in an important way|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20240625002748}}</ref>
*'''SBD''': Abbreviation for [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|Super Battle Droid]].<ref name="RC:TZ" /><ref name="RC:HC" />
*'''Scamp''': An expletive or exclamation used by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].<ref name="BTS" />
*'''Scare the [[mopak]] out of''': To terrify someone.<ref name="The Last Jedi" /> Similar to the real-world rude slang phrase "scare the shit out of."<ref name="Scare the shit">{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/scare+the+shit+out+of|text=scare the shit out of (one)|quote=''rude slang'' To shock or frighten one very suddenly or severely.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230617202712}}</ref>
*'''Scare the [[Stang/Legends|stang]] out of''': To terrify someone.<ref name="SOL" /> Similar to the real-world rude slang phrase "scare the shit out of."<ref name="Scare the shit" />
*'''Scarhead''': A derogatory term for a [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="Star by Star" />
*'''[[Schutta/Legends|Schutta]]''': Insult specific to [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|females]],<ref name="Legacy glossary 3" /> derived from the name of a [[Weasel/Legends|weasel]]-like creature native to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="Quest Path">''[[Jedi Quest: Path to Truth]]''</ref>
*'''Schutta-spawn''': An insult.<ref name="Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world noun phrase "son of a bitch."<ref name="Son of a" />
*'''Scrag-end''': Used by a drunken [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] to address [[Etain Tur-Mukan]].<ref name="RC:HC" /> "Scrag" is a real-world noun for a rawboned or scrawny person or animal.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/scrag|text=scrag|quote='''1 :''' a rawboned or scrawny person or animal|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20240719054612}}</ref>
*'''Scrap City''': Slang for where [[Droid/Legends|droids]] go when outmoded.<ref name="HSSE" />
*'''Scraphead''': A derogatory term for [[Battle droid/Legends|CIS battle droids]]. [[Officer/Legends|Officers]] were known to use the term when they were frustrated at having incompetent [[Troop/Legends|troops]].<ref name="Headgames">''[[The Clone Wars: Headgames]]''</ref>
*'''Scratch gravel!''': A phrase meaning "go away!"<ref name="SWGMSR" /><ref name="SWRPG2" /><ref name="HSLL" /> Similar to the real-world [[Wikipedia:American English|American English]] expression "go pound sand."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.phrases.org.uk/meanings/go-pound-sand.html|text=Go pound sand|quote='Go pound sand' is an American expression of disdain, along the same lines as 'get lost', 'go and play in the traffic', etc.|work=The Phrase Finder|archivedate=20221211102339}}</ref>
*'''Screaming like a stuck [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]]''': To scream or shriek in pain, loudly.<ref name="KOTOR2" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "squeal like a stuck pig."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/squeal-like-a-stuck-pig|text=squeal like a stuck pig|quote=to scream very loudly, as though you are in a lot of pain|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20221221114739}}</ref>
*'''Scruffy-looking''': A derogatory modifier.<ref name="ESB" />
*'''Scroll-gun''': A small, two-shot weapon disguised to appear as a document.<ref name="HSLL" />
*'''Scum''': An insult, used to refer to [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]],<ref name="ESB" /> [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebels]] or any other undesirable individuals.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Real-world term.
*'''Scut''' or '''scuttlebutt''': Gossip, usually among military forces, that pertains to concurrent or forthcoming events; the rumor mill.<ref name="Scut">{{CSWECite|III|131|scut}}</ref><ref name="CSW1">[[Classic Star Wars 1|''Classic Star Wars'' 1]]</ref> "Scuttlebutt" is a real-world [[Wikipedia:American English|American English]] noun.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/scuttlebutt|text=scuttlebutt|quote=news or information that may or may not be true|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20220503084649}}</ref>
*'''[[Seccer]]''': [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]]-wide slang for a [[Police officer/Legends|public security officer]]. See also: '''Cop'''.<ref name="Invincible" />
*'''A [[Seed/Legends|seed]] in a field of [[Bantha dung/Legends|bantha droppings]]''': Used to describe something that was hard to find.<ref name="Rogue Squadron 17">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 17|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 17]]</ref> Similar to the real-world idiom "a needle in a haystack."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/needle-in-a-haystack|text=a needle in a haystack|quote=something that is impossible or extremely difficult to find, especially because the area you have to search is too large|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20250710231559}}</ref>
*'''See you on the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]''': An exclamation.<ref name="DF" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "I'll see you in hell."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://idioms.thefreedictionary.com/I%27ll+see+you+in+hell|text=(I'll) see you in hell!|quote=A curse laid upon someone, especially when parting.|work=[[Wikipedia:The Free Dictionary|''The Free Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230423204804}}</ref>
*'''Self service''': [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] slang for [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''Sensor frisk''': Electronic search technique used by security services to locate concealed objects.<ref name="GTSWU1" />
*'''Sepper''': Slang for a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]. See also: '''Seppie''' or '''seps'''<ref name="ROTSn" />
*'''Seps''': Slang for a group of Separatists. Commonly used by [[Omega Squad|Omega]] and [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]].<ref name="RC:HC" />
*'''Seppie''': Slang term for Separatist.<ref name="SP" /><ref name="ROTSn" />
*'''Set-down''': Slang for the act of landing a [[Starship/Legends|starship]].<ref name="SME" />
*'''Shabla''': Impolite emphatic adjective in [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]]<ref name="RC:TZ" />
*'''Shags''': Elrood sector slang for [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], generally used affectionally, but sometimes derisively.<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''Shak''': A word used in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] [[before the Republic]] that could mean "excrement" or be used as an insult or expletive. Phrases include "[you] little shak," "scare the shak out of me," "shak on [someone]," and "for shak's sake."<ref name="Into the Void" />
*'''Shakedown cruise''': A trial run for a new or repaired starship to determine whether the vessel was spaceworthy.<ref name="GTSWU1" />
*'''Share [[Galactic coordinates/Legends|coordinates]]''': A metaphor implying collusion or connection.<ref name="DF:SFTE" />
*'''Sharpie''': A term used by [[Crimson Jack/Legends|Crimson Jack]] to describe [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], apparently meaning a "sharp-witted person."<ref name="SW11" />
*'''Shas'mink''': A [[Laerdocian]] expletive.<ref name="Specter of the Past" />
*'''Shassa''': An old [[Mistryl Shadow Guard|Mistryl]] battle curse.<ref name="VOTF" /><ref name="Specter of the Past" />
*'''Shavit''': An expletive used by the farmers of [[Pakrik Minor]]. Translates roughly as feces.<ref name="Specter of the Past" />
*'''Shebs''': Mando'a for backside or rear.<ref name="RC:TZ" />
*'''Shee''': A [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]] curse.<ref name="LSSM" /><ref name="SP" />
*'''[[Shik]]''': A vulgar term to describe one who someone despises.<ref name="Aurorient 1">[[Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: The Aurorient Express 1|''Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: The Aurorient Express'' 1]]</ref> Near-identical to real-world noun "shit."
*'''[[Shiny/Legends|Shinie]]''': Slang for a rookie [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]].<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref>
*'''Shiny boy''': Slang for [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]].<ref name="RC:TZ" />
*'''Shiny stick''': Slang for [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="RC:TZ" />
*'''Shock''': Slang term commonly used by [[Invids|Invid]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], in reference to disabling a target with [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]].<ref name="IJ" />
*'''Shoe's on the other side of your mouth''': Do something you should not have.<ref name="SWL2" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "put your foot in your mouth."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/put-foot-in-mouth|text=put your foot in your mouth|quote=to say or do something that you should not have, esp. something that embarrasses someone else|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230329225403}}</ref>
*'''Shoot like a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] militia''': Derogatory remark referring to the accuracy of military and criminal forces or droids.<ref name="KOTOR2" />
*'''Shoot the [[Star/Legends|stars]]''': Elrood sector slang for engaging the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="Planets Three" />
*'''The Show''': A phrase referring to [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] combat.<ref name="SWRPG2" /><ref name="HSSE" />
*'''Shrew''': Insult used by [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] about [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]].<ref name="Tempest" /> Real-world insult for an ill-tempered woman .<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/shrew|text=shrew|quote=an offensive word for a woman who is considered to be unpleasant and easily annoyed, and who argues a lot|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20220504001509}}</ref>
*'''Shunfa''': A curse.<ref name="Allegiance" />
*'''Simmer down''': Phrase meaning to calm down or relax.<ref name="VOTF "/> Real-world phrase.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/simmer-down|text=simmer down|quote=to become less angry or excited about something|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20170824225847}}</ref>
*'''Sissy Strap''': [[Gallisport]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] slang for a seatbelt.<ref name="SG" />
*'''[[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] [[Blood/Legends|Blood]]!''': A Mandalorian exclamation.<ref name="KOTOR2" />
*'''Sithling''': A slang term for a Sith.<ref name="SWKE12">[[Knight Errant: Escape 2|''Knight Errant: Escape'' 2]]</ref>
*'''Sith me''': An expletive used when shocked.<ref name="Legacy 4" /> Similar to the real-world rude [[Wikipedia:British English|British English]] exclamation "bugger me."<ref name="Bugger me" />
*'''[[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]]''': An expletive.<ref name="XRS" /> Could also be used as a metaphor for a contemptible person, e.g. "He's the Sithspawn who gave us up to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imps]]";<ref name="Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref> or to emphasize a statement, e.g. "nervous as Sithspawn."<ref name="XRS" /> Could also refer to a specific kind of creature mutated or created by [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]].<ref name="Tales Companion">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world noun hellspawn, used in fiction about creatures from Hell. In real life, it is used to refer to any monster or vicious person.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.wordsense.eu/hellspawn|text=hellspawn|quote=''fantasy'' - A creature or creatures from Hell. ''by extension'' - Any monster; a vicious fiend or villain.|work=WordSense|archivedate=20230501043354}}</ref>
*'''[[Sithspit/Legends|Sithspit]]''': An expletive used throughout the galaxy.<ref name="JO" /><ref name="JK:JA" /> Similar to the real-world vulgar noun "bullshit."
*'''Sitting [[Duck/Legends|duck]]''': An open target that can easily picked off.<ref name="TPM" /> Real-world noun.<ref name="Quack quack">{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/sitting-duck|text=sitting duck|quote=someone or something that is very easy for an enemy to shoot or attack|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20220308190743}}</ref>
*'''Sitting [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]]''': A vulnerable target.<ref name="TFU II novel">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]]</ref> Similar to the real-world noun "sitting duck."<ref name="Quack quack" />
*'''The Six Ps''': [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] slang for an acronym meant to encourage proper mission planning. Tactfully translated by [[Niner Skirata|RC-1309]] to [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Bardan Jusik]] as "Proper Planning Prevents Pi...''Inadequate'' Performance."<ref name="RC:HC" />
*'''[[List of phrases and slang/Legends#S|Skefta]]''': A [[Spice/Legends|narcotic]]. Skefta dens, controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Huttese syndicate]], were popular in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="TMA" />
*'''Skel''': A prisoner/bounty.<ref name="Republic 65">[[Republic 65|''Republic'' 65]]</ref>
*'''[[Skifflin]] is out of the sack''': A phrase meaning that a secret has been revealed.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world phrase "let the cat out of the bag."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/let-the-cat-out-of-the-bag|text=let the cat out of the bag|quote=to allow a secret to be known, usually without intending to|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20210506132818}}</ref>
*'''[[Skifter/Legends|Skifter]]''': An illegal face-changing [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] card often employed by cheaters.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" /><ref name="THG">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref>
*'''Skip''': [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]/[[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] fighter pilot slang for a [[Yorik-et|coralskipper]].<ref name="Ylesia">''[[The New Jedi Order: Ylesia]]''</ref>
*'''Skrag''': An expletive; variant '''skrag it'''.<ref name="Side Trip 4" /> Similar to the real-world swear word "damn" and the exclamation "damn it."
*'''Skroggin{{'}}''': Derogatory modifier used by [[Jariah Syn]].<ref name="SWL3" /> Similar to the real-world swear word "f*cking."
*'''[[Skug/Legends|Skug]]''': An insult.<ref name="Sand Blasted" /> Also used in the exclamation '''vench my skug'''.<ref name="Nampi" />
*'''[[Bone/Legends|Skull]]''': Slang term commonly used by [[Invids|Invid]] pilots, in reference to the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] starfighter.<ref name="IJ" />
*'''Skulo''': An insult,<ref name="Invincible" /> possibly of [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] origin.<ref name="Cuss" />
*'''Skyboy''': A term used to address [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].<ref name="SW8" /><ref name="SW5" />
*'''Slag!''': Gallisport [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] gang slang. A swear word. Phrases included "'''slag it'''" and "'''slag you'''."<ref name="SG" /> Phonetically similar to the real-word word "damn" and the phrases "damn it" and "damn you."
*'''Slap''': An [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] barrage. "'''Light slap'''" indicated a light barrage, while "'''hard slap'''" meant a heavy barrage.<ref name="RB" />
*'''Slatt''': A [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] exclamation.<ref name="TAS" />
*'''[[Slicer/Legends|Slicer]]''': One who is highly skilled in the technical aspects of computers. Also '''slicing''', etc.<ref name="KOTOR2" /> A pun on the real-world nouns "hacker" and "hacking."
*'''[[Sleemo/Legends|Sleemo]]''': A [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] insult, pronounced ''slay-mo'', and translating as "slimeball."<ref name="TPM" /> "Slimeball" is a real-world noun for an unpleasant person.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/slimeball|text=slimeball|quote=an extremely unpleasant or horrible person|work=[[Wikipedia:Oxford Learner's Dictionary|''Oxford Learner's Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230423211157}}</ref>
*'''Slim''': Slang term commonly used by [[Invids|Invid]] pilots, in reference to the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]].<ref name="IJ" />
*'''Slime sap''': Derogatory term used by [[Mama/Legends|Mama the Hutt]].<ref name="Hunt for Ziro" />
*'''Slime sucker''' or '''slimesucker''': Derogatory term used by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="Dark Empire 4">[[Dark Empire 4|''Dark Empire'' 4]]</ref><ref name="Firefight" /> Similar to the real-world noun "suck-egg," referring to someone who is young, stupid, or despicable.<ref name="Suck-egg" />
*'''Slipping the beam''': A metaphor implying precision or excellence.<ref name="GNN6" />
*'''Slug rifle''': Slang term for [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]].<ref name="SP" />
*'''Slugthrower''': Term for any projectile-based weapon.<ref name="SP" />
*'''Smack the snot out of''': To beat up severely.<ref name="SP" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "beat the shit out of."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/beat-the-shit-out-of|text=beat the shit out of|quote=to give a severe beating to|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230603234806}}</ref>
*'''Smelly''': [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] slang for [[Imperial Security]].<ref name="Rebel Alliance Sourcebook" />
*'''Smokecover''': A fib or deceit meant to mislead.<ref name="VOTF" /> Real-world term.
*'''Smooth as lake ice''': Expression for something having occurred with little to no trouble.<ref name="VOTF" />
*'''Smooth as [[Ottegan silk/Legends|Ottegan silk]]''': Go very smoothly.<ref name="Bushford Databank">{{DB|character|slytherbushforb|Bushforb, Slyther}}</ref> Similar to the real-world idiom "smooth as silk," meaning "very smooth."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/%28as%29%20smooth%20as%20silk|text=(as) smooth as silk|quote=very smooth|work=[[Wikipedia:Merriam-Webster|Merriam-Webster]]|archivedate=20240615110214}}</ref>
*'''[[Snake/Legends|Snake]]''': A derogatory term used for [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]].<ref name="POP" /> Real-world derogatory word for a treacherous person.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/snake|text=snake|quote=2. a treacherous or deceitful person|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230423211157}}</ref>
*'''Snarkin<nowiki>'</nowiki>''': A derogatory modifier.<ref name="SWR59">[[Republic 59|''Republic'' 59]]</ref>
*'''Snark it''': An expletive.<ref name="SW43" />
*'''Snigvold''': A derisive [[Ansionian]] term, used by the [[Alwari]] nomads, to describe another individual, particularly one from a different tribal clan, in a rude way.<ref name="TAS" />
*'''[[Snogwash/Legends|Snogwash]]''': An expletive used for disbelief in a statement made by someone else.<ref name="PoNR" /> A pun on the real-world noun "hogwash."<ref name="Hogwash" />
*'''Snot''': A contemptible person.<ref name="KE5">[[Knight Errant: Aflame 5|''Knight Errant: Aflame'' 5]]</ref><ref name="Knight Errant novel">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref> Real-world noun.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/dictionary/snot|text=snot|quote='''2''' [count] disapproving: a rude and annoying person|work=''The [[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|Britannica]] Dictionary''|archivedate=20221004100630}}</ref>
*'''Snowmen''': Slang for [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial stormtroopers]].<ref name="HSLL" />
*'''[[Snubfighter/Legends|Snubfighter]]''': Small [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] like [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] or [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] that are seen as expendable.
*'''Sod''', '''sodder''': Slang for unfortunate beings.<ref name="DS" /><ref name="BTS" /> "Sod" is an offensive real-world [[Wikipedia:British English|British English]] word for a person, or someone or something considered difficult or unpleasant.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/sod|text=sod|quote=[ C ] UK offensive '''something or someone considered unpleasant or difficult''' (...) [ C ] UK offensive '''a person'''|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230621211545}}</ref>
*'''[[Eclipse/Legends|Solar ecliptic]]''': Imaginary circular plane emanating from a [[Star/Legends|star]]. The ecliptic's orientation was defined by the average of the majority of the system's orbital bodies.<ref name="GTSWU1" />
*'''So many cocoons in one hutch''': Many efforts invested in one enterprise.<ref name="TCD"/> Similar to the real-world idiom "put all your eggs in one basket."<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/put-all-eggs-in-one-basket#google_vignette|text=put all your eggs in one basket|quote=to depend for your success on a single person or plan of action|work=[[Wikipedia:Cambridge University Press and Assessment|''Cambridge Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20241225185522}}</ref>
*'''Son of a—''': Exclamation used by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].<ref name="SOL" /> Similar to the real-world exclamation "son of a bitch."<ref name="Son of a" />
*'''[[Son of a bantha/Legends|Son of a bantha]]''' or '''son-of-a-bantha''': Phrase serving both as an exclamation<ref name="MBS" /><ref name="Honor Among Thieves">''[[Honor Among Thieves]]''</ref> and an insult.<ref name="A Tangled Web">''[[The Last of the Jedi: A Tangled Web]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world vulgar slang phrase "son of a bitch" and the variant "son-of-a-bitch."<ref name="Son of a" />
*'''Son of a [[Barve/Legends|barve]]''': An insult.<ref name="Legacy 4" /> Similar to the real-world vulgar slang phrase "son of a bitch."<ref name="Son of a" />
*'''Son of a bitch''': An insult.<ref name="Tyrant" /> Real-world vulgar slang phrase.<ref name="Son of a" />
*'''Son-of-a-drabble''': An exclamation.<ref name="Allegiance" /> Similar to the real-world vulgar slang phrase "son-of-a-bitch."<ref name="Son of a" />
*'''Son of a [[durkii]]''': An insult; see '''son of a barve'''.<ref name="JQTDG" />
*'''Son of a gun''': A mild insult.<ref name="THG" /> Real-world slang for a rogue or rascal.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/son-of-a-gun|text=son of a gun|quote=''slang, mainly US and Canadian'' a rogue or rascal: used as a jocular form of address |work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archivedate=20230501041250}}</ref>
*'''Son-of-an-[[ibbot]]''': Exclamation of surprise; see '''son-of-a-drabble'''.<ref name="MBS" />
*'''Son of a jumpin<nowiki>'</nowiki>...''': An insult; see '''son of a barve'''.<ref name="ESB novel" />
*'''Son-of-a-[[Kath hound/Legends|kath-hound]]''': An insult; see '''son-of-a-drabble'''.<ref name="Path of Destruction">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> 
*'''Son of a [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]]''': An insult; see '''son of a barve'''.<ref name="Fool's Bargain" />
*'''Son of a [[monkey-lizard]]''': An insult; '''son of a barve'''.<ref name="JQTDG" />
*'''[[Son of a murglak]]''': Phrase serving both as an exclamation<ref name="Republic 46">[[Republic 46|''Republic'' 46]]</ref> and an insult.<ref name="Republic 21">[[Star Wars (1998) 21|''Star Wars'' (1998) 21]]</ref> Similar to the real-world vulgar slang phrase "son of a bitch."<ref name="Son of a" />
*'''Son-of-a-[[Mynock/Legends|mynock]]''' (plural: '''sons of mynocks'''): An insult.<ref name="LCSTB" /><ref name="Legacy of the Sith">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world vulgar slang phrase "son-of-a-bitch" and the plural form "sons of bitches."<ref name="Son of a" />
*'''Son of a [[Nerf herder/Legends|nerfherder]]''': Exclamation,<ref name="Sandstorm" /> similar to the real-world vulgar slang phrase "son of a bitch."<ref name="Son of a" />
*'''Son of a [[Pervickian dung camel]]''': An insult; see '''son of a barve'''.<ref name="LSSM" />
*'''Son of a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]''' or '''son-of-a-rancor''': An insult.<ref name="Side Trip 3">"[[Side Trip]]"</ref><ref name="Contraband adventure">{{WEGCite|story=The Politics of Contraband (adventure)|book=The Politics of Contraband|reprint=1}}</ref> Similar to the real-world phrase "son of a bitch" and the variant "son-of-a-bitch."<ref name="Son of a" />
*'''Son of a [[ratt]]''': An insult; see '''son of a barve'''.<ref name="JQTDG" />
*'''Son of a [[ruskakk]]''': An insult; see '''son of a barve'''.<ref name="LSSM" /> Similar to the real-world vulgar slang phrase "son of a bitch."<ref name="Son of a" />
*'''Son-of-a-schutta''': An insult; see '''son-of-a-drabble'''.<ref name="Abyss" />
*'''Son of a Sith harlot''': An exclamation used to express disappointment; see '''song of a nerfherder'''.<ref name="The Swarm War" /> 
*'''Son of a slorth''': An insult; see '''son of a barve'''.<ref name="The Last One Standing: TTOBF" />
*'''Son of a sow''': A [[Gamorrese|Gamorrean]] curse; see '''song of a nerfherder'''.<ref name="POT" /> 
*'''Son of a [[Exogorth/Legends|space slug]]''': An insult; see '''son of a barve'''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>
*'''Son of a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] viper''': An insult; see '''son of a barve'''.<ref name="SWS" />
*'''Son of a [[tairn]]''': An insult; see '''son of a barve'''.<ref name="DS" />
*'''Sons of [[Slime/Legends|slime]]-[[Demon/Legends|devils]]''': An insult.<ref name="The Last One Standing: TTOBF" /> Similar to the real-world vulgar slang phrase "sons of bitches," the plural form of "son of a bitch."<ref name="Son of a" />
*'''Sorcerer''': Slang for a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], used by Admiral [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Motti]] to refer to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="ANH" />
*'''Space''': Slang term for killing a person by exposing them to the vacuum of space, usually by launching them out of an airlock.<ref name="LCFO" />
*'''Space ape''': Slang for a lascivious male, used by [[Jolli]] to insult her fellow [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] when they tried to kiss her.<ref name="SW12">[[Star Wars (1977) 12|''Star Wars'' (1977) 12]]</ref>
*'''Space freak''': An insult [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] uses to refer to the [[Star-Hoppers of Aduba-3]].<ref name="SW10" />
*'''Space gas''': A phrase used by [[Jolli]], apparently meaning "empty talk."<ref name="SW11" /> Similar to the real-world noun "hot air."
*'''Space-happy''': An insult used by Han Solo to describe [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who attacked him on [[Aduba-3/Legends|Aduba-3]], perhaps meaning "insane"; compare "nova-happy."<ref name="SW7" />
*'''Space it''': Forget it.<ref name="DS" />
*'''[[Spacer/Legends|Spacer]]''': Slang term used to describe individuals who live most of their lives in space.
*'''Space-ugly''': Slang for an ugly spacer, used by [[Amaiza Foxtrain/Legends|Amaiza Foxtrain]] to insult the [[Cloud-Riders/Legends|Cloud-Riders]].<ref name="SW9" />
*'''[[Spast]]!''': An interjection.<ref name="JK2:JO">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref>
*'''Spawn of a space slug''': An insult.<ref name="Domain of Evil">''[[Domain of Evil]]''</ref> Similar to the real-world noun phrase "son of a bitch."<ref name="Son of a" />
*'''Spawn of [[Nilgarian worm]]''': An insult.<ref name="Goatgrass" /> Similar to the real-world noun phrase "son of a bitch."<ref name="Son of a" />
*'''Spear two [[Fleek eel/Legends|fleek-eels]] with one trident''': Proverbial expression denoting achieving multiple goals with little effort.<ref name="SOTEn" /> Similar to the real-world idiom "kill two birds with one stone."<ref name="Birds stone" />
*'''[[Spice/Legends|Spice]]''': Slang for any narcotic or otherwise intoxicating substance that is not ingested through drinking.
*'''Spiritwave''': The technique Obi-Wan used to defeat Darth Maul.<ref name="DM:SH" />
*'''Spit blaster bolts''': A term meaning to explode in fierce anger.<ref name="Specter of the Past" /> Similar to the real-world phrase "spit fire".
*'''Sprinkle''': Gallisport swoop gang slang for [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="SG" />
*'''Spun a [[loop pastry]]''': Made something sound more dramatic than it is.<ref name="OF" />
*'''Squark that''': Expletive used by the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Keluda]].<ref name="Republic 47">[[Republic 47|''Republic'' 47]]</ref> Phonetically similar to the real-world offensive phrase "f*ck that."
*'''Squid Head''': A nickname for the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="SOTEn" />
